 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
 


 Role Overview
 
 Are you a seasoned People Ops professional who loves the intersection of HR technology, compliance, and employee experience? We are looking for a high\-performing Specialist to join our global team and own critical pillars of our employee journey! In this role, you will be the absolute guardian of our global data integrity and the primary gatekeeper for candidate compliance from hire to retire.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
**Roles (The Mission)** 



* Lifecycle \& Data Guardian: Own the integrity of employee data throughout the entire lifecycle within Workday, ensuring absolute accuracy.
* Risk \& Compliance Lead: Act as the primary gatekeeper for global compliance by managing and executing robust background verification (BGC) processes.
* Operational Excellence Partner: Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees, HRBPs, and external vendors to streamline workflows.



**Responsibilities (The Work)** 



* Workday Data Management: Execute complex global data changes (transfers, promotions, comp updates, terminations) and manage mass uploads using Workday EIBs.
* End\-to\-End BGC Ownership: Partner with external vendors to trigger, track, and review comprehensive background checks. Safely escalate and resolve discrepancies.
* Lifecycle Management: Support crucial milestones across the employee journey—from seamless onboarding documentation to compliant offboarding.
* Ticketing Support: Resolve HR service requests efficiently through ServiceNow (SNOW) while maintaining strict SLA adherence.



**Results (The Output \& Success Metrics)** 



* Zero\-Error Data Quality: Achieve and sustain a $\>99\\%$ accuracy rate in data entries and EIB uploads within Workday.
* 100% Compliance Audits: Ensure 100% of active personnel files have fully completed, verified background check clearances within required timelines.
* SLA \& TAT Optimization: Consistently hit and exceed established turnaround times for resolving HR tickets and onboarding data setup.
* Vendor Efficiency: Optimize internal workflows to reduce the average cycle time for background check completions.


**Qualifications** 
* 5\+ years of core experience in People Operations/HR Ops with deep employee lifecycle exposure.
* Mandatory tech skills: Hands\-on proficiency with Workday Core HCM (including EIB execution) and ServiceNow (SNOW).
* Compliance expertise: Proven track record of managing high\-volume, global background verification processes and vendor relations.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and data privacy capabilities (GDPR/CCPA awareness is a huge plus).

description:
Job Description – HR Executive (PMS)
 
**Company:** 
 Auramah Valley
 



**Location:** 
 Shimla, Himachal Pradesh
 



**Department:** 
 Human Resources

 3–4 Years

 Full\-Time
 


 Job Summary
 
 Auramah Valley is seeking a detail\-oriented and analytical HR Executive – PMS to manage and coordinate the organization’s Performance Management System (PMS). The candidate will be responsible for collecting departmental reports, maintaining performance data, compiling dashboards, and ensuring timely monthly reporting and analysis.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Manage and coordinate the complete PMS process across departments.

* Maintain employee performance records and documentation.
* Support management in performance review meetings and reporting.

 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 * Minimum 3–4 years of experience in PMS coordination and reporting.
* Strong knowledge of PMS tools, dashboards, and reporting systems.
* Excellent proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and MIS reporting.
* Experience in compiling and analyzing large sets of performance data.
* Strong follow\-up, coordination, and communication skills.
* Ability to work with deadlines and manage monthly reporting timelines efficiently.
* Good analytical and organizational skills.


 Preferred Candidate Profile
 * Experience in hospitality or corporate HR operations will be preferred.
* Detail\-oriented and highly organized professional.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments effectively.
* Strong presentation and reporting skills.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
As a member of our Talent Acquisition team, you will play a key role in shaping Riveron’s employer brand and supporting our ability to hire top talent. We are a people\-first company, focused on delivering exceptional experiences for both our candidates and our internal stakeholders.
   

  

 As a Senior Associate, you will partner closely with recruiters, hiring teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver a high\-touch, seamless recruiting experience. This role is highly execution\-focused and detail\-oriented, with an emphasis on coordination, communication, and operational excellence. You will also gain exposure to broader recruiting strategy and have opportunities to grow your career in talent acquisition.
   

  

 This role is based in India and will support recruiting efforts across U.S. teams, requiring regular collaboration across time zones.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* 4\-6 years of experience in a coordination, administrative, or similar operational and tactical role supporting recruiting teams based in the U.S.
* Comfortable working across U.S. time zones and collaborating with global stakeholders
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and follow\-through
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience working in an applicant tracking system, with hands\-on experience in Ashby strongly preferred
* Demonstrated experience maintaining data integrity, governance, and reporting within an ATS (e.g., ensuring accurate candidate records, tracking pipeline data, and supporting reporting needs)
* Strong proficiency with scheduling tools, Outlook calendars, and Microsoft Office products
* High level of professionalism, accountability, and a client service mindset
* You’re looking to build a career in talent acquisition and enjoy being at the center of fast\-paced, people\-driven work
* You take pride in creating organized, thoughtful experiences and bring a strong sense of ownership to your work
* You are proactive, highly responsive, and detail\-oriented, with a focus on delivering an exceptional candidate and stakeholder experience
* You have a demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, learn quickly, take initiative, and bring structure to evolving processes and changing priorities


**What You’ll Do**
* Coordinate and schedule interviews across multiple time zones, ensuring a seamless experience for candidates and interviewers
* Serve as a point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process, delivering a high\-touch, white\-glove experience
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date candidate data in our applicant tracking system (Ashby)
* Partner with recruiters and hiring teams to ensure smooth execution of the recruiting process, proactively following up and driving progress
* Identify opportunities to improve scheduling workflows, communication, and overall candidate experience
* Support reporting and data tracking to help drive recruiting insights and efficiency
* Assist with recruiting programs and initiatives
* Contribute to operational excellence by maintaining strong processes, documentation, and data integrity

 At Riveron, we partner with clients—from global multinationals to high\-growth private entities—to solve complex finance challenges, guided by our DELTA values: Drive, Excellence, Leadership, Teamwork, and Accountability. title: Assistant Manager- Talent Consulting EY- Parthenon
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Talent Consultant\- Supervising Associate**
 If you are looking for a challenging and rewarding career experience as a Talent Consultant in a high\-growth organization, we have a role here. At EY GDS we value wellbeing, curiosity, and agility as an individual. We create teams of inspiring, teaming, and belonging. We care for our business, society, and client. Our purpose is building a better working world. Does that resonate with you? We look forward to working with you.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 You will be responsible for supporting the Talent agenda for a business unit in EY GDS and will be the key point of contact for employees, counselors (managers) and business unit leadership on a range of talent\-related matters. You will drive and implement the engagement agenda, work closely with other members of the team to provide change leadership, increase workforce capability and talent management. You will build a deep understanding of business unit direction and Talent related topics/issues to ensure successful implementation of key projects and processes.
   

  

 You will need to be collaborative, influential, and work across functions to execute on attracting, assimilate, develop, engaging and retain key talent. You will drive project management for various HR (Human Resource) initiatives, including Workforce Planning, Performance Management, Talent transformation, Talent Development and Reward \& Recognition etc
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Support the Strategic Talent Consultant in designing a sustainable and scalable engagement framework for the business unit and take ownership for the delivery
* Provide support to the business leaders and counsellors in the implementation of engagement initiatives across the business unit
* Anticipate issues and needs within the business unit and address these effectively
* Provide insight on people issues, particularly ER (Employee Relations) cases within business unit, provide a robust point of view on business decisions and their impact upon people
* Ensure that all necessary people management and development activity required to support the business unit is delivered in the most professional and effective manner
* Execute innovative HR programs
* Ensure resolution of HR related issues and handle these effectively within the given timeline, involving the Employee Relation Talent function where required or expected
* Facilitate change and support the implementation and successful adoption of special projects and initiatives in the business unit, for example: Performance Management, Talent transformation, Talent Development and Reward exercises
* Ensure compliance to local regulations and manage risks (e.g., performance management risk)


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, ability to develop clear, actionable plans in support of an overall business unit strategy
* Ability to engage and influence others, with good change management skills and a desire to act as a change agent
* Strong clients focus with the ability to build good relationships with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels
* Strong Employee Relations experience of complex disciplinary, grievance and performance management activities, especially with employees in senior management/leadership level
* Develop strong relationship with other Talent Centre of Excellence teams to ensure that centrally developed products and initiatives meet the requirements of the business unit
* Ability to work with ambiguity and build consensus across diverse, often global, groups


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Graduate or a post graduate qualification in a Business or Human Resource discipline is desirable.
* 6\-8 years of proven HR generalist experience (e.g., performance management, employee relations
* Relevant working experience in delivering / managing talent initiatives


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience working in a consulting organization or in a similar professional services environment
* Experience of working in a cross\-border, virtual environment would be beneficial


**What We Look For**
* Keen interest to invest time for self\-learning, seeking opportunities to work on cross\-functional HR projects
* Working collaboratively in a team environment
* A self\-starter, independent\-thinker, curious and creative person with desire and passion


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK (United Kingdom) – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We will introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

**What Are GIS and Remote Sensing?**
 Before diving into job opportunities, it’s important to understand what GIS and Remote Sensing are:
   

  

* GIS (Geographic Information System): A system that captures, stores, checks, and displays data related to positions on the Earth’s surface. It helps in mapping and analyzing spatial information.
* Remote Sensing: The process of acquiring information about an object or area from a distance, typically using satellite or aerial sensors.


 These technologies are widely used in agriculture, disaster management, urban planning, forestry, mining, meteorology, and environmental conservation—making them essential for public sector initiatives.
   

  

**Importance of GIS and Remote Sensing in Indian Government Projects**

* Forest Survey of India (FSI)
* Swachh Bharat Abhiyan (urban mapping)


 Because of these initiatives, central and state governments are consistently hiring skilled GIS and Remote Sensing professionals for project implementation and monitoring.

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a motivated 3D Modeler to create high\-fidelity, real\-time 3D assets used in immersive Virtual Reality (VR) training experiences and also to create VR content on simple plate\-form. This role sits at the intersection of mechanical engineering and modern real\-time / game\-engine pipelines. The successful candidate will convert complex engineering inputs—such as CAD models, drawings, bills of material, and technical specifications—into accurate, optimized, and visually clear 3D assets suitable for interactive VR training environments.
   

  

 This position works closely with VR developers, instructional designers, and engineering subject\-matter experts to ensure all assets are technically correct, performant on target hardware, and aligned with instructional intent.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Engineering\-to\-VR Asset Creation**
* Translate complex mechanical drawings, CAD models, and specifications into accurate, VR\-ready 3D models and assemblies.
* Maintain correct scale, tolerances, interfaces, and part relationships consistent with engineering intent.
* Interpret incomplete or ambiguous engineering data and collaborate with subject\-matter experts to resolve issues.
* Build assemblies and sub\-assemblies suitable for interactive training, including exploded views and service\-oriented breakdowns.


**Real\-Time Optimization for VR**
* Create real\-time\-ready geometry using best practices for VR and game engines, including clean topology, efficient UV layouts, and appropriate polygon budgets.
* Generate and manage Levels of Detail (LODs) to ensure stable frame rates in VR environments.
* Bake high\-poly detail into low\-poly assets using normal maps and supporting texture maps.
* Optimize assets for draw calls, texture memory usage, and shader complexity based on VR performance constraints.


**Texturing, Materials, and Visual Clarity**
* Create high\-quality Physically Based Rendering (PBR) materials using metal/roughness workflows.
* Produce textures, decals, and material variants that enhance realism while supporting training clarity.
* Develop visual variants such as simplified models, cutaways, highlights, and color\-coded components to support instructional goals.
* Ensure materials respond correctly across varied lighting conditions used in VR training scenarios.


**Workflow, Reviews, and Delivery**
* Follow a consistent end\-to\-end modeling pipeline from CAD ingestion through mesh preparation, optimization, texturing, review, and final polish.
* Prepare assets with clean hierarchies, pivots, naming conventions, and documentation for seamless integration into VR applications.
* Participate in design and technical reviews, incorporating feedback from engineers, developers, and instructional designers.
* Maintain organized source files and documentation to support reuse, updates, and long\-term asset maintenance.


**Required Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of professional experience creating real\-time 3D assets for VR, games, simulation, or interactive training.
* Strong proficiency with at least one major DCC tool such as Blender, Maya, or 3ds Max.
* Demonstrated experience with real\-time asset optimization, including LODs, baking, and texture optimization.
* Hands\-on experience with PBR texturing workflows and material creation.
* Mechanical engineering background (degree or equivalent practical experience) with the ability to interpret technical drawings and CAD data.
* Portfolio demonstrating hard\-surface and mechanical modeling with evidence of real\-time optimization.


**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications**
* Experience developing assets for industrial equipment, manufacturing tools, or technical training content.
* Familiarity with Unity or Unreal Engine for validating scale, lighting, and performance.
* Experience working with CAD\-to\-real\-time conversion pipelines.
* Understanding of VR\-specific usability considerations such as scale perception, visual comfort, and interaction clarity.


**Tools \& Technologies**
* Modeling / DCC Tools: Blender, Maya, 3ds Max (ZBrush optional for high\-detail sculpting)
* Texturing \& Materials: PBR workflows, Substance Painter or equivalent tools
* Optimization Techniques: LOD generation, texture atlases, normal map baking, polygon and draw\-call optimization
* Real\-Time Platforms: Unity and/or Unreal Engine (for asset validation and integration support)
* File Formats \& Delivery: Real\-time optimized formats such as FBX and glTF, with clean hierarchies and documentation

* 8\+ years in robotics motion control, with deep hands\-on knowledge of kinematics, dynamics, and inverse/forward kinematics (IK/FK).
* Production experience with MoveIt2 or an equivalent motion planning library.
* Familiarity with motor control protocols (CAN, EtherCAT) at the implementation level — can debug an EtherCAT bus, not just use a vendor SDK.
* Force/torque control implementation experience for at least one production application.
* Has shipped a motion\-control stack in a manufacturing or logistics setting that ran at production cadence.



**Preferred experience** 



* Experience with bipedal locomotion control (whole\-body MPC, ZMP\-based balance, or learned policies).
* Background in dexterous manipulation research or deployment (multi\-fingered hands, in\-hand manipulation).
* Exposure to functional\-safety design and the safety\-case construction for collaborative or mobile robots.
* Familiarity with ros2\_control hardware abstraction layer and writing custom controllers.

title: Firmware Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Firmware Engineer
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, Karnataka (On\-Site)
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Joining Type:** 
 Immediate
 



**CTC (Annual):** 
 Competitive Salary

 2 \- 6 years
 



  





  




**About Us** 

 Technoculture Research is re\-imagining how the world measures health. We build micro\-scale electrochemical laboratories that place lab\-grade accuracy directly in the hands of clinicians, community health workers, and even patients at home. Our platform fuses microfabricated electrodes, novel surface chemistries, and microfluidics to run protein, nucleic\-acid, and metabolite assays within minutes. By replacing costly optical detection with electron sensing, we slash instrument and per\-test costs by roughly an order of magnitude, making precision diagnostics truly accessible. Our mission is clear: make diagnostics abundant so that every critical health decision is guided by immediate, affordable results, wherever care happens.
 



**Website:** 

 www.technoculture.io
 




  





  




**Job Description** 

 We are seeking an experienced Firmware Engineer to develop real\-time, deterministic firmware for our robotics and diagnostics platforms. You will be central to building the embedded stack that powers our humanoid robots, grippers, and data collection fleet. Strong knowledge of Linux, C programming, and real\-time systems is essential.
 


**Responsibilities** 
* Develop real\-time firmware for MCUs (STM32, ESP32, RP2040\) driving motors, sensors, and actuators in our humanoid and UMI grippers.
* Implement communication stacks (CAN bus, EtherCAT, USB, SPI, I2C) for multi\-node robotic architectures.
* Write drivers for IMUs, force\-torque sensors, encoders, cameras, and depth sensors across the data collection fleet.
* Build embedded Linux applications on NVIDIA Jetson and Raspberry Pi for data logging, video streaming, and multi\-sensor synchronization.
* Develop firmware for time\-synchronized multi\-camera capture pipelines feeding our foundation model.
* Implement real\-time control loops (PID, impedance, admittance) for dexterous manipulation hardware.
* Design bootloaders, OTA update systems, and onboard diagnostics for field\-deployed robots.
* Optimize for low\-latency, deterministic performance in safety\-critical robotic contexts.



  





  




**Qualifications** 
1. B.Tech or M.Tech in Electronics, Computer Engineering, or related discipline.
2. 2\-6 years of embedded firmware development experience in C and C\+\+.
3. Hands\-on experience with ARM Cortex\-M MCUs (STM32 preferred).
4. RTOS experience with FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or equivalent.
5. Proficiency with CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, and USB protocols.
6. Strong knowledge of Embedded Linux and cross\-compilation toolchains.

**Position:** 
 Product Manager
   

  

**Experience:** 
 2–4 Years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Onsite (Ahmedabad)
   

  

**About The Role**
* We are looking for a Product Manager to join our AI Division and drive the vision, strategy, and execution of AI\-powered products. You will work closely with engineering, design, data science, and business teams to ship high\-impact features that solve real customer problems using AI/ML and GenAI capabilities.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Product Strategy: Define product vision, roadmap, and feature prioritization aligned with business goals and customer needs.
* Requirement Gathering: Translate business problems into clear PRDs, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria that engineering teams can build from without ambiguity.
* AI Product Execution: Partner with AI/ML engineers to scope, evaluate, and ship LLM and ML\-powered features — including defining quality benchmarks (accuracy, latency, cost, hallucination thresholds).
* Stakeholder \& Client Management: Lead client conversations, requirement discussions, demos, and feedback loops; manage internal and external stakeholders.
* Discovery \& Research: Conduct user interviews, usability tests, market scans, and competitor analysis to identify opportunities and validate solutions.
* Data\-Driven Decisions: Define product KPIs, set up dashboards, run A/B tests and experiments, and use data to inform prioritization.
* Agile Delivery: Own backlog grooming, sprint planning, and Agile ceremonies; ensure timely, predictable delivery.
* Documentation: Maintain PRDs, release notes, internal playbooks, and product knowledge base.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work with design on UX flows and wireframes; with engineering on technical feasibility; with marketing/sales on launches and GTM.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 2–4 years of experience as a Product Manager, Associate Product Manager, or similar role.
* Strong understanding of the product lifecycle and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Working knowledge of LLMs, GenAI, or AI/ML products — ability to evaluate AI output quality and reason about accuracy, latency, and cost trade\-offs.
* Proven ability to write crisp PRDs, user stories, and product documentation.
* Data\-driven mindset; comfort with metrics, dashboards, and basic SQL.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Hands\-on experience with client communication and requirement gathering.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Notion, Figma, or similar tools.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. MBA is a plus.


**Good To Have**
* Exposure to LLM playgrounds (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) and prompt engineering.
* Familiarity with APIs, Postman, and reading basic technical documentation.
* Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP) and system scalability concepts.
* Experience working on SaaS or B2B AI products.
* Exposure to design thinking, user research frameworks, or growth experimentation.

Works on complex content and projects. Responsible for content of a product line and/or process. Acts as a mentor and provides training to less experienced writers.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Research, write, edit, assemble, and update product and customer\-facing documentation.
* Translate complex source materials and data into clear, accessible content.
* Produce guides, specifications, training materials, policies, procedures, newsletters, and user reference materials.
* Coordinate documentation for product releases and ensure instructions are accurate and consistent.
* Collaborate with stakeholders, SMEs, product managers, and analysts to gather requirements and validate content.
* Verify citations, source data, and content accuracy across assigned products.
* Conduct quality reviews to ensure formatting, usability, readability, relevancy, and link functionality.
* Apply taxonomy guidelines to classify and tag web content and documents.
* Track industry and subject matter developments to update existing content and create new materials.
* Develop documentation plans that define message, format, and content strategy.
* Identify opportunities to improve products, processes, workflow, and content efficiency.
* Provide peer review, coaching, training, and work direction to less experienced team members.
* Participate in project planning and cross\-functional meetings to support high\-quality documentation delivery.


**About You**
* Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and content assembly skills.
* Experience developing technical, product, or customer\-facing documentation.
* Ability to analyze and synthesize information from multiple sources.
* Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and subject matter experts.
* Strong research skills and ability to track trends and relevant developments.
* Knowledge of editorial standards, documentation best practices, and quality review processes.
* Experience validating citations, data, formatting, and content accuracy.
* Ability to create clear, easy\-to\-use documentation and reference materials.
* Familiarity with taxonomy/tagging guidelines and content classification.
* Strong project coordination, organization, and time management skills.
* Ability to identify workflow, process, and product improvement opportunities.
* Confidence in training, coaching, or guiding less experienced team members.
* Customer\-focused mindset with the ability to understand and respond to user needs.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to handle work of diverse scope and complexity.


**What’s in it For You?**

* Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real\-world solutions. title: Business Analyst-Cybersecurity
description:
The Cyber Business Analyst is responsible for supporting the delivery of Beazley’s Group CISO security
 



 maturity initiatives by providing analytical insight, process clarity, and stakeholder alignment. This role
 



 works closely with the Group CISO and Programme Manager to ensure cybersecurity projects are
 



 informed by accurate data, well\-mapped processes, and clearly defined business and regulatory requirements.
 



 We are looking for a Business Analyst (BA) with experience in cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and data\-driven decision\-making, capable of supporting large\-scale cyber maturity programmes aimed at reducing the risk of cyber threats and ensuring alignment with evolving regulatory obligations.
 



  
 



 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Business Analysis \& Requirements Gathering
	+ Collaborate with stakeholders to capture and document business, technical, and regulatory requirements for cybersecurity initiatives, particularly in IAM and PAM domains.
	+ Translate complex identity and access management concepts into clear, actionable business terms.
* IAM \& PAM Transformation Support\[CW1] \[AM2]
	+ Support the design and implementation of IAM and PAM solutions, including role\-based access control (RBAC), least privilege enforcement, and privileged session monitoring.
	+ Assist in defining access governance models, user lifecycle processes, and policy enforcement mechanisms.
	+ Ensure alignment with regulatory and audit requirements for identity and access controls.
	+ Collaborate with stakeholders to analyse Segregation of Duties (SoD) conflicts, support SoD rule set definition,
	+ Assist in integrating CMDB insights to enhance access control decisions and risk mitigation strategies.
* Regulatory Compliance Mapping
	+ Interpret and map requirements from key regulatory frameworks such as:
		- DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act)
		- CBI (Central Bank of Ireland) Guidelines
		- NIS/NIS2 (Network and Information Systems Directive)
	+ Ensure cybersecurity projects align with these frameworks and that compliance obligations are clearly documented and traceable.
* Data Analysis \& Reporting
	+ Analyse security\-related data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
	+ Develop dashboards and reports to support decision\-making and track progress against KPIs and compliance metrics.
* Process Mapping \& Optimisation
	+ Document current\-state cybersecurity and access management processes and identify gaps or inefficiencies.
	+ Design future\-state process maps aligned with security best practices and regulatory standards.
* Stakeholder Engagement
	+ Act as a bridge between technical teams, business units, compliance, and third\-party vendors.
	+ Facilitate workshops, interviews, and walkthroughs to validate requirements and solutions.

description:
**Description**
 How often have you had an opportunity to be at ground zero of a disruptive, fast\-growing, and evolutionary global Amazon service? How frequently do you get to start from the foundation and solve customer needs at a global scale in a fast\-growing entertainment streaming industry? At Prime Video, we are pioneering a new generation of digital supply chain at a remarkable speed to accelerate our market position and global reach. If this sounds interesting, come build the future of streaming entertainment with us!
   

  

 Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies \- all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows from Originals and Exclusive content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add\-on channels which they can cancel at anytime and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast\-paced, growth business \- available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic and global environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do.
   

  

 We are searching for a Business Analyst II to join our Workforce Management (WFM) team within Content Publishing Operations. In this role, you will be the analytical engine closest to site operations — delivering rapid\-response analysis, building operational dashboards, and creating performance tracking solutions that enable site leadership to make real\-time, data\-driven decisions. You will own the delivery of site\-specific analytical solutions including associate scorecards, queue health alerting, and capacity analysis that directly impact how our operations teams manage day\-to\-day workforce performance.
   

  

 This role operates at the intersection of WFM strategy and site execution: you will translate centralized workforce frameworks into site\-level analytical tools that make strategic concepts actionable on the ground. The ideal candidate is a fast\-moving analyst who thrives on solving urgent operational problems, is comfortable building scrappy solutions with light engineering (scripting, automation, dashboard development), and is energized by being the go\-to analytical partner for site leaders across India and Japan.
   

  

 This role is based in India and operates on a shifted schedule to enable meaningful overlap with U.S. Pacific and Costa Rica time zones. This ensures you are connected to the core WFM team, engaged directly with cross\-functional stakeholders, and able to participate in global leadership forums — giving you visibility and influence well beyond a typical site\-based analytics role.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design, build, and maintain workforce analytics dashboards and data infrastructure that deliver validated, accurate metrics across the organization
* Produce executive\-level WBR (Weekly Business Review) reporting that informs leadership decisions on workforce optimization, capacity planning, and investment stewardship
* Build and maintain real\-time metrics dashboards and alerting mechanisms that enable proactive capacity management and minimize idle time
* Provide same\-day rapid\-response analysis for urgent site operational questions, delivering actionable insights under tight timelines
* Create analytical solutions originating from site operational requirements and priorities, ensuring site leaders have the data they need to drive performance outcomes
* Own workforce metrics calculation logic — including productivity (TPH), utilization, queue health, and efficiency — ensuring data quality and consistency across sites
* Support capacity analysis for resourcing decisions by delivering accurate, timely data on workforce deployment, utilization, and availability
* Build automated reporting and alerting pipelines using SQL, scripting, and BI tools to reduce manual effort and increase analytical responsiveness
* Execute on the team's technical roadmap, delivering milestones on schedule with proactive communication of progress and blockers to leadership


**About The Team**
 The Workforce Management team within Prime Video Content Publishing Operations is responsible for maximizing the return on investment of our global workforce through strategic design of how headcount is allocated, measured, planned, and governed. We operate in the critical space between Resource Planning and Site Operations — translating funded headcount into optimal deployment strategies, establishing measurement systems, validating efficiency gains, and providing capacity analysis across a multi\-site, multi\-program network spanning Costa Rica, India, and Japan.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
* Experience in advanced SQL \& ability to write complex queries from scratch from multiple tables
* Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages
* Experience in medium to high complexity data analysis using Excel, requiring the use of pivot tables and/or other data manipulation features and formulas
* Experience communicating research findings and analysis in both written and spoken channels
* Ability to work a shifted schedule with overlap into U.S. Pacific time zone hours (typically India evening hours) to support global team collaboration and stakeholder engagement


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent
* Experience scripting for automation (e.g., Python, Perl, Ruby)
* Experience building data pipelines or automated ETL processes
* Experience producing executive\-level reporting (WBR, MBR, QBR formats)
* Familiarity with workforce productivity metrics (throughput, utilization, scheduling efficiency)

title: Software Engineer I
description:
**Job Description**
 Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in our team to partner with the Business to provide a comprehensive view.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer I at JPMorgan Chase within the Model Risk Governance \& Review (MRGR) team, you will be developing tools for MRGR Analytics to improve efficiency and reduce duplication of effort, including resource management and cost optimization tools. You will provide support for model reviewers and governance teams in building independent testing and efficiency tools. You will be delivering high\-quality solutions by emphasizing the importance of data controls, testing, user experience and continuously seek input from users to align efforts with their objectives. Bring your expertise to JPMorgan Chase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient.
   

  

 The team is responsible for conducting independent model validation and model governance activities to help identify, measure, and mitigate Model Risk in the firm. Within MRGR, the Chief Operating Office (COO) supports model risk stakeholders in their review and governance activities, and drives certain governance activities itself, with responsibility for: product ownership, process engineering and software development for model risk technology and analytics; model risk reporting; administration of oversight committees; project management of the review and governance pipeline; coordination of regulatory/audit deliverables including capital stress testing exercises; and general business management. Within COO, MRGR Analytics provides technology solutions for MRGR and its clients, assisting them in performing their tasks more efficiently, accurately, and with better control. Majority of the solutions are built within Athena (JPMorganChase’s proprietary framework using Python language), Tableau and QlikView/QlikSense frameworks.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Develop tools to automate various tasks in the model governance and review lifecycle.
* Build various dashboard reports to help manage the body of work that MRGR deals with.
* Translate the existing business requirements in model risk management space into business applications using applied development work mostly in Python using in\-house built Python framework.
* Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) into existing systems to enhance automation, reporting capabilities and decision\-making processes.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify opportunities for LLM integration and develop solutions that leverage LLM capabilities.
* Build intelligent solutions to support the activities of MRGR staff.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* A Bachelors or Masters degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics discipline with significant exposure to computer programming.
* Minimum 2 years of full stack application development.
* Proficient in Python and knowledge of Tornado web framework / TypeScript / React required.
* Good understanding of software architecture, object\-oriented programming and design patterns.
* Experience with integrating machine learning models, including LLMs, into enterprise applications.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to interface with other functional areas in the firm on business requirements.
* Risk and control mindset: ability to think critically, assess user needs and create design solutions to meet user needs.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Experience in working with large data sets.
* Exposure to LLM integration and deployment in real\-world applications.
* Strong UI/UX designing skills.
* Experience in model risk management or financial services space.


**ABOUT US**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world’s most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants’ and employees’ religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we’re setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.
   

  

 Risk Management helps the firm understand, manage and anticipate risks in a constantly changing environment. The work covers areas such as evaluating country\-specific risk, understanding regulatory changes and determining credit worthiness. Risk Management provides independent oversight and maintains an effective control environment.

 This role is focused on building polished digital experiences across premium websites, landing pages, SaaS/product interfaces, and motion\-led web experiences.
 



  





 You don’t need to be highly experienced already. But you should have strong frontend basics, good visual sense, and the curiosity to learn how high\-quality websites and interfaces are actually built.
 



 This is not a role for someone who only wants to write basic React components. We’re looking for someone who wants to improve in layout, responsiveness, animation, frontend polish, performance, and clean implementation.

* HTML, CSS, JavaScript fundamentals

* Tailwind CSS and component\-based UI
* Pixel\-perfect frontend implementation
* GSAP and Framer Motion animations
* 3D experiences
* Landing pages, case study pages, service pages, and product interfaces
* Clean code structure and reusable components
* Basic frontend performance practices
* Creative frontend experiments for internal and client projects



  




**Good fit if you** 

  




* Have built small frontend projects, website sections, clones, or experiments
* Understand basic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React
* Care about visual details like spacing, typography, alignment, and animation timing
* Are comfortable receiving feedback and improving quickly
* Can share GitHub, CodePen, portfolio, live links, or any frontend experiments

* GSAP

* WebGL

**What we’re not looking for**

description:
### **About EarnIn**



As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real\-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.



We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world\-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world\-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.


**POSITION SUMMARY**



Join EarnIn's Platform Services team for a 6\-month internship building an AI\-powered solution that directly impacts our Platform Infrastructure. You'll own meaningful end\-to\-end work across two connected workstreams — reducing platform toil and accelerating delivery for every engineer at EarnIn — under the guidance of senior platform engineers. This position will be based in Bengaluru, India, as part of our expanding site, and is a contract role from July 2026 to February 2027, targeting university students. This role requires two days a week in the office as part of our growing site location.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Build components of the AI First Responder agent — an automated on\-call triage system that integrates Datadog, Incident.io, and Slack — including agent tooling, evaluation harnesses, and integration workflows.
* Contribute to the IaC migration away from Terraform Cloud — refactoring Terraform modules, cleaning up policies, and building migration scaffolding that clears tech debt and accelerates platform delivery.
* Use AI\-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) throughout both workstreams to develop applied AI skills in a real infrastructure context.
* Write clean, well\-tested, and well\-documented code that lasts beyond the internship.
* Collaborate with engineers across the Bengaluru and Mountain View Platform teams; present your work and learnings to the broader team.
* Shadow incident triage and on\-call workflows to build context on production operations (no on\-call responsibilities).


**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**


* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree (B.E., B.Tech, M.Tech, or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field from an Indian university; graduating December 2026 or later.
* Experience with Python, Go, or another backend language — coursework or personal projects count.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), containers (Docker), or infrastructure\-as\-code concepts (Terraform, Kubernetes); classroom or personal\-project experience counts.
* Eagerness to learn and actively use AI\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as part of your day\-to\-day workflow — this is a core expectation, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Comfort working in a Linux/CLI environment and with Git\-based version control.
* Ability to communicate progress proactively, ask good questions, and document your work clearly.
* Self\-starter mindset — you take initiative, seek feedback, and iterate quickly with moderate guidance.
* Prior internship or project experience in platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or site reliability is a plus.
* Familiarity with Datadog, PagerDuty, or similar observability and incident\-management tools is a plus.
* Experience calling LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) or building agent\-style workflows in a project context is a plus.
* Exposure to Kubernetes or Helm in any environment (lab, personal cluster, coursework) is a plus.


\#LI\-Hybrid



At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. * Effective communication skills to coordinate and collaborate with team members, regulatory agencies, and other stakeholders.

title: Cluster Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
With thousands of hotels in over 100 countries and territories, Hilton offers countless opportunities to delight. From an open door to a welcoming smile and an exceptional experience, we offer the millions of travellers who stay with us every year a welcome they will never forget. In addition to our flagship brand, Hilton Hotels \& Resorts, the family of brands includes Waldorf Astoria, LXR, Conrad, Canopy, Curio Collection, DoubleTree, Hilton Garden Inn, Hampton and many others.



If you appreciate the impact global travel can have on the world, you may be just the person we are looking for to work as a Hilton Team Member. Because it’s with Hilton where we never forget the reason we're here: to delight our guests, Team Members, and owners alike.

  




**The Cluster Talent Acquisition Manager is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end recruitment function for five hotels i.e., Hilton and Hilton Garden Inn Bengaluru Embassy Manyata Business Park, Hilton Bangalore Embassy Golf Links, Hilton and Hilton Garden Inn Bangalore Embassy Tech Village, aligning recruitment activities with business goals, and ensuring a consistent, high\-quality talent pipeline. This role requires strong strategic planning, operational excellence, and a passion for building Hilton’s reputation as an employer of choice.**



### **What will I be doing?**



As the Cluster Talent Acquisition Manager, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:


* Responsible for managing the entire recruitment process (end\-to\-end) for all five hotels in the cluster.
* Report directly to the Cluster Director of Human Resources (Cluster DHR).
* Assist with the annual hotel manning budget by participating in headcount planning discussions with department heads.
* Develop and implement the annual cluster recruitment strategy to ensure timely hiring of qualified candidates.
* Maintain and expand effective recruitment channels and execute strategic recruitment activities.
* Ensure all open positions are posted on relevant recruitment platforms with brand\-compliant job advertisements.
* Source candidates, conduct first\-round interviews for all positions below Director level, and coordinate with hiring managers for subsequent interviews.
* Participate in campus hiring drives, job fairs, and recruitment campaigns across schools, colleges, and universities.
* Establish and maintain a systematic database of candidate profiles and recruitment activities.
* Monitor recruitment effectiveness and market trends, providing insights and strategy updates to HR leadership.
* Ensure timely candidate communication, feedback, onboarding, and smooth check\-in processes.
* Maintain professionalism and protect the Hilton employer brand across all recruitment touchpoints.
* Manage agency partnerships, internship programs, and monitor performance and agreements during contract periods.
* Conduct intern engagement activities to support intern conversion efforts.
* Maintain accuracy of recruitment and HR\-related systems, and provide relevant training.
* Conduct orientation and training sessions on recruitment systems and interview best practices for hiring managers.
* Support other HR initiatives such as employee data management, visa applications, team events, and facility oversight.
* Deliver accurate and timely recruitment reports to support HR analytics and business insights.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior team members, ensuring adherence to recruitment protocols and conducting performance reviews.
* Create and update recruitment content for internal and external media platforms.
* Perform any other duties as assigned by management.
* The Management reserves the right to make changes to this job description at its sole discretion and without advance notice.

**What are we looking for?**



A Cluster Talent Acquisition Manager serving Hilton is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:


* Minimum of 8–10 years of experience in talent acquisition, preferably within large\-scale 5\-star hotel environments.
* Proven track record of managing end\-to\-end recruitment across multiple properties.
* Strong experience with recruitment platforms like Taleo, Darwin Box, campus hiring, and talent marketing.
* Pre\-opening experience is an added advantage.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
* Proficient in HR systems and recruitment reporting tools.
* Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple projects simultaneously.
* A passion for people, hospitality, and driving Hilton's employer brand in the market.

  




**What will it be like to work for Hilton?**



Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full\-service hotels and resorts to extended\-stay suites and mid\-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travellers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands. Our vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And, our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all!

title: INTERN - TALENT & CULTURE
description:
FlytBase**HR****Pune, India (Onsite)****Full\-time****0\-1 years**
  
WHAT WE DO
FlytBase builds the world's leading Physical AI drone autonomy platform, powering mission\-critical operations across 300\+ enterprise sites in 40\+ countries. Its customers include Fortune 500 leaders such as Shell, CSX, UK Police, Airbus, Anglo American, Dole and Statnett. Explore some of our key deployments here \- flytbase.com/case\-studies.
With a presence in the US and Pune, India, FlytBase is building the nervous system for large industrial sites. The company operates at AI speed, with autonomy and intelligence at its core. Our lean team thrives in a high\-agency, high\-velocity environment where AI is not a side project, it is the operating system for how we think, build, and grow.
THE ROLE
This isn't your typical HR internship where you fetch coffee and update spreadsheets. You'll be FlytBase's Swiss Army knife for talent and culture — one day you're researching AI talent pipelines, the next you're creating content that shows why top engineers choose FlytBase over Google. You'll work directly with leadership on projects that actually matter: employer branding campaigns, community outreach experiments, recruiting automation, whatever moves the needle that week.
We're looking for someone who gets excited about ambiguity, not overwhelmed by it. You'll have real ownership over projects that impact how FlytBase attracts and retains world\-class talent. This role could evolve into anything — full\-time recruiting, content marketing, operations — depending on where you create the most value and what lights you up.
WHAT YOU'LL OWN
• Content creation for employer branding across LinkedIn, Twitter, and lifeatflytbase.com
• Build the content \+ community \+ events engine for aiatflytbase.com
• Community engagement with drone, AI, and startup ecosystems
• Competitive intelligence on talent strategies in the Physical AI space
• Find the high\-leverage recruits the team needs tackled this quarter
BEST SUITED FOR
• Students or recent grads who've already conducted hackathons, events, or clubs
• Experience with AI tools — Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable for personal projects
• Natural curiosity about how fast\-growing companies attract and retain talent
• Comfortable with ambiguous projects that don't have clear playbooks
• Strong writing skills — you can explain complex ideas simply
• Social media savvy, especially LinkedIn and Twitter for professional content
• Interest in drone technology, AI, or B2B software (bonus, not required)
• Track record of finishing what you start, even when no one's watching
WHAT MAKES YOU A FLYTER
• High agency: You see a problem and start solving it before being asked. You don't wait for perfect instructions.
• AI\-native thinking: You reach for AI tools to 10x your output, not just to check grammar.
• Learning velocity: You'd rather try three imperfect experiments this week than plan one perfect project next month.
• Curiosity over credentials: You care more about understanding how things work than collecting resume lines.
• Ownership mindset: You measure success by impact created, not hours logged or tasks completed.
WHAT WE DON'T WANT
• Internship collectors who want FlytBase on their resume but nothing else
• People who need detailed instructions for every task and panic when projects evolve
• Anyone who asks 'what exactly will I be doing?' before 'what problem can I help solve?'
• Students who see this as a placeholder until they find something 'real'
• People who avoid AI tools or treat them as cheating rather than force multipliers
• Anyone who needs constant validation or can't work independently
WHY FLYTBASE?
• H3 Philosophy: We're building a company that's Happy, Healthy, AND High\-Performing. Not as a balance—as a harmony. We move fast without burning out.
• Radical Ownership: You won't need permission to experiment, build, or lead. If you see a problem, you own the solution.
• Mazaa Aayega: Our internal motto. Yes, the work is intense. But it's also deeply meaningful and genuinely fun.
• Systems That Scale: We don't celebrate one\-off heroics. We build compounding systems that create leverage.
• In\-Person Energy: We work from our Pune office because proximity accelerates everything—ideas, feedback, trust, and impact, but travel globally for customer meetings, tradeshows, and deployments.
THE PERKS
• High agency team and sense of purpose
• International Travel—we travel to all 6 continents (sorry, no business in Antarctica yet)
• Thought leadership \& public speaking opportunities at online \& physical events
• No\-cap budget for AI tools, courses, or experiments
• Latest tech stack and tools—whatever helps you move faster
• Top\-tier health coverage for you
• Unlimited leave policy \& flexible working hours (no punch\-in/out)
• A damn good team to work with
WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH
You'll report to our Talent Lead but work closely with founders and department heads across the company. You'll get direct exposure to how leadership thinks about hiring, culture, and scaling a category\-defining Physical AI company.
READY TO FLY?
If you're the kind of person who builds side projects for fun and thinks AI tools are the best thing since sliced bread, we want to hear from you. This isn't just an internship — it's a chance to help shape how FlytBase thinks about talent in the age of Physical AI.

--------------------------------------------------------


We are looking for a highly driven and analytical HR Intern to support strategic talent initiatives, program management activities, and large\-scale recruitment operations. The ideal candidate should be someone who enjoys problem\-solving, working with data, driving operational excellence, and collaborating across teams to improve candidate and hiring experiences.

Thoughtworks is evolving from a services\-led technology consultancy toward a platform\-powered services model, with **AI/works™**, our agentic development platform, at the centre of that shift.


As that evolution continues, the role of digital experience is changing too. In the AI era, B2B websites can no longer act as static content catalogues. Buyers arrive ready to validate, compare, and explore, and they expect experiences that are clear, dynamic, credible, and useful.


At Thoughtworks, we are rethinking what that means across **Thoughtworks.com** and a growing set of **AI\-powered applications used in marketing**. They should help people engage with our thinking, explore our capabilities, and experience the brand in a way that feels intelligent, human, and distinctive.

* Support the planning, execution, and tracking of key talent initiatives.

### **Communication \& Stakeholder Management**


* Drive clear, professional, and timely communication with candidates, recruiters, hiring teams, and external stakeholders.
* Support communication strategies for hiring campaigns, engagement initiatives, and program updates.
* Ensure a seamless and positive stakeholder experience through strong coordination and responsiveness.

### **Process Excellence \& Operations**


* Contribute to process improvement initiatives and operational efficiency projects.
* Support documentation, reporting, and standardization of recruitment/program processes.
* Assist in creating scalable mechanisms to support high\-volume hiring initiatives.

* Minimum **CGPA of 8\.0** and above throughout academics.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Comfortable working with large datasets, dashboards, and reporting tools.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Interest in HR strategy, program management, talent operations, and analytics.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------


* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and presentation tools.
* Exposure to dashboards, reporting, or data visualization tools is a plus.
* Prior internship/project experience in HR operations, analytics, program management, or coordination is preferred.

**What You’ll Gain**
--------------------


* Exposure to large\-scale talent and campus hiring programs.
* Hands\-on experience in strategic HR operations and analytics.
* Opportunity to work with cross\-functional stakeholders and leadership teams.

We are hiring a **Business Development Executive / Sales Executive** to support the growth of our HR technology platform, **SkillBaseHire**.

The selected candidate will be responsible for communicating with company HR teams, recruiters, consultancies, and business teams to introduce our product and explain how SkillBaseHire helps companies hire candidates based on verified skills.

This is a **full\-time remote role**. Candidates with good communication skills, confidence, and interest in sales or customer communication are welcome to apply.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Contact HR teams, recruiters, consultancies, and companies through calls, emails, and messages.
* Explain the features and benefits of the SkillBaseHire platform.
* Promote the product and generate interest from companies.
* Schedule product demos or follow\-up calls when required.
* Maintain lead details and follow\-up status.
* Build good relationships with HR and business contacts.
* Share daily/weekly updates on contacted companies and responses.
* Support the team in improving sales and customer communication.

**Required Skills:**

* Good communication skills.
* Confidence to speak with HR and business professionals.
* Ability to explain product details clearly.
* Basic computer and internet knowledge.
* Self\-motivated and willing to learn.
* Freshers with strong communication skills can also apply.

**Requirements:**

* Candidate must have a laptop and mobile phone.
* Stable internet connection is required.
* Should be comfortable working from home..

**Benefits:**

* Full\-time work\-from\-home opportunity.
* Good pay based on skills and performance.
* Training will be provided.
* Opportunity to grow with a startup HR tech platform.

Pay: ₹3,000\.00 \- ₹5,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

title: PS Operations Manager - IND
description:
**About Kinaxis**
-----------------



Elevate your career journey by embracing a new challenge with Kinaxis. We are experts in tech, but it’s really our people who give us passion to always seek ways to do things better. As such, we’re serious about your career growth and professional development, because *People matter* at Kinaxis.  

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers based in Ottawa, Canada. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, and support 40,000\+ users in over 100 countries. As a global leader in end\-to\-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries. We are expanding our team in Chennai and around the world as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.  

Our journey in India began in 2020 and we have been growing steadily since then! Building a high\-trust and high\-performance culture is important to us and we are proud to be Great Place to Work® CertifiedTM. Our state\-of\-the\-art office, located in the World Trade Centre in Chennai, offers our growing team space for expansion and collaboration.

**Location**
============


Chennai / Bangalore.**About the team**
------------------


The PS Operations team is a strategic and execution\-focused within our Professional Services organization which is responsible for providing day\-to\-day leadership for a team of PS Operations professionals and driving improvements in PS operations processes. This role will be instrumental in designing and implementing workflows that enhance service delivery,  

drive operational efficiency, data quality and scalability. You will work cross\-functionally to identify process improvement opportunities, and lead implementation projects for improvement initiatives.
**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop the Professional Services Operations team to ensure high performance, effective resource allocation to support business priorities and project demands, and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Analyze current\-state processes and design future\-state workflows that drive operational efficiency and scalability across PS operations, including developing and maintaining process maps, SOPs, and governance frameworks.
* Manage end\-to\-end process improvement initiatives from ideation through implementation, including defining scope, timelines, success metrics, and collaborating cross\-functionally across PS, Finance, IT, and HR to ensure seamless execution.
* Drive adoption of operations changes through effective change management strategies, including stakeholder engagement, training facilitation, and clear communication of goals and outcomes —in collaboration with the Senior Change Manager to align with broader PS transformation initiatives and change management best practices.
* Oversee daily execution of operational processes, including project setup, resource management, subcontracting, time and project health tracking, billing support, and reporting, while ensuring consistent adherence to processes and monitoring SLAs/KPIs to ensure timely and quality service delivery.
* Drive data\-driven decision\-making by overseeing the creation and delivery of operational reports and dashboards, defining and monitoring KPIs to measure impact of process changes.
* Deliver actionable insights to leadership and continuously evaluate performance to identify improvement opportunities.

**What we are looking for**
===========================

* 5\+ years in business process improvement, operations management, or program/project management within a professional services or consulting environment, delivering measurable process improvements, with at least 2 years of people management experience.
* Strong proficiency in process mapping tools and continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma), with ability to design future\-state end\-to\-end cross\-functional business processes and document SOPs and governance frameworks.
* Experience with PSA tools (Salesforce, FinancialForce, Mavenlink, etc.) and reporting platforms (Power BI, Tableau), with ability to analyze complex data sets and translate insights into actionable improvements.
* Excellent people leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills with ability to influence change and facilitate cross\-functional collaboration.
* Deep understanding of professional services workflows and business models.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment with competing priorities and ability to balance strategic thinking with hands\-on operational execution.

 **Preferred Qualifications :**  

Certification in recognized process improvement methodology (Lean, Six Sigma).  

Project Management qualification (PMP, Prince2, or equivalent)


**Work With Impact:** Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.  


**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Ford, Unilever, Yamaha, P\&G, Lockheed\-Martin, and more.  


**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:** Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to net\-zero operations strategy for the long term. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.


*People matter* at Kinaxis and these are some of the perks and benefits we created for our team:  


* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide day off on the last Friday of every month)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well\-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs and training and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons

  



For more information, visit the Kinaxis web site at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com.

  


Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. Please note that this contact information is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used to inquire about application statuses.


*Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description, to identify candidates whose education, experience and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.*

title: HR Shared Service Specialist II
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**



Reporting to the HR Services Supervisors and/or Managers, the HR Specialist II is responsible for processing HR transactions and exceptions that are escalated from HR Specialist I.



This position is integral to the processing of end\-to\-end and specialized service transactions accurately and in compliance with company policies.



The HR Specialist II plays a key role in supporting critical HR initiatives that drive the overall effectiveness of the function. In doing so, they will focus their efforts within one of the following three areas:



* **HR Operations emphasis** \- Facilitate onboarding processes, manage data integrity, ensure compliance, and provide support for various regional HR Shared Services operations.


* **Compensation emphasis** \- Assist with the annual compensation review, manage ad hoc compensation requests, and process one\-time payments along with other regional compensation services.


* **Reporting and Mass Data emphasis** \-Generate human capital reports, manage mass uploads, and utilize established templates for efficient data management and processing.



**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**


* Process a wide range of employee transactions within Workday and service a wide range of requests in BMC Helix, ensuring accuracy and adherence to service level agreements.
* Manage and resolve exceptions and level 2 transactions, providing solutions to more complex employee inquiries and issues.
* Provide guidance and support to Tier 1 Specialists, acting as a point of escalation for complex cases.
* Collaborate with HR team members to identify and implement process improvements, aiming to enhance efficiency and employee experience.
* Coordinate and execute Workday transactions related to HR operations, such as job changes, personnel changes, and position management.
* Facilitate the onboarding process for new hires, ensuring all necessary paperwork is completed accurately and efficiently to promote a smooth and positive new joiner experience.
* Maintain organized and up\-to\-date employee files, ensuring compliance with legal and internal requirements for data privacy and protection.
* Conduct regular audits of HR processes and employee records to ensure compliance with company policies and identify areas for improvement.
* Provide training and support to Tier 1 Specialists on HR operations procedures, enhancing their ability to address employee inquiries and transactions effectively.
* Support development and maintenance of documentation and records, including knowledge of content related to areas of service emphasis and ensuring compliance with internal policies and audit requirements.
* Systematically initiate and monitor the end\-to\-end execution of the annual compensation review process, ensuring alignment with company policies, standards, and targets.
* Process a variety of compensation\-related transactions, including salary adjustments, bonuses, and one\-time payments, ensuring accuracy and compliance with established guidelines.
* Respond to employee inquiries related to compensation, providing clear and accurate information to resolve issues and enhance employee understanding.
* Maintain accurate records of compensation transactions and ensure proper documentation is in place for auditing purposes.
* Collaborate with Tier 1 Specialists to address compensation\-related inquiries and provide guidance on compensation policies and procedures.
* Generate automated reports and dashboards to meet customer requests, interpreting customer needs and applying Workday knowledge to arrange and provide access to relevant insights.
* Manage mass data uploads, including EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builders), ensuring proper execution and adherence to data integrity standards, while troubleshooting issues and utilizing knowledge of Workday back\-end processes.
* Respond to inquiries related to reporting and data management, providing timely and accurate information to both employees and HR team members.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, Agency HR, and other HR team members and other stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvements in data management and reporting, enhancing overall efficiency.


**EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:**



Essential:


* + 4\+ years of demonstrable experience managing HR Operations (running the transaction/service\-oriented aspects of HR) and relevant experience leading HR Operations or HR Shared Services.
	+ Exhibit substantial project, program and process management skills.
	+ Proficient in HCM and service management platforms, software, and applications.
	+ Clear grasp and understanding of leading practices in HR and Shared Services operations.
	+ Ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced and changing environment.
	+ Problem solving and critical thinking skills.
	+ Ability to manage vendors including but not limited to Technology and Software vendors, Benefits Administrators and Providers, as needed to support center operations and ensure services are provided to the organization.
	+ Strongly demonstrated verbal and written communication and presentation skills.

Desirable:


* + Experience effectively influencing and coaching team members.
	+ Project management and change management experience.
	+ Demonstrable experience performing complex reporting and analysis.
