title: EMEA Payroll Specialist
description:
**Location:** Bengaluru, India, India


**Employment Type:** FullTime


**Location type:** Hybrid


**Department:** Operations

  

**Purpose in Every Position**


Pebl puts a world of talent at your fingertips. With our AI\-powered Global Work Platform™, companies can hire, pay, and manage employees in 185\+ countries—removing risk, red tape, and guesswork from global growth. Backed by more than a decade of compliance leadership and local expertise, Pebl helps businesses move fast, stay compliant, and scale with confidence. With Pebl, companies everywhere can hire great talent anywhere.

**Where Your Work Moves the Needle.**


At Pebl, every team member drives our success. Joining us means more than filling a role—you’re accountable for results and impact. Our values guide how we operate, execute, and collaborate across borders. By putting them into action, you’ll help us scale faster, compete harder, and lead the future of global work.

**How You'll Make an Impact:**

**Payroll processing \& delivery**

* Manage end\-to\-end payroll processing for multiple countries, ensuring accurate and timely completion of semi\-monthly and monthly payroll cycles.
* Maintain payroll calendars, track deadlines, and proactively follow up with clients and In\-Country Partners (ICPs) to ensure on\-time submission of payroll inputs.
* Collect, review, and validate payroll inputs (e.g., new hires, terminations, salary changes, allowances, bonuses, leave, and reimbursements) for completeness and accuracy.
* Coordinate with ICPs to submit payroll inputs and ensure payroll processing aligns with local statutory requirements and internal policies.
* Review payroll previews received from ICPs and perform payroll validation checks (e.g., gross\-to\-net variances, net pay reasonableness, statutory contributions, and deductions).
* Support payroll approval workflows, ensuring approvals are obtained and properly documented before payroll finalization.
* Ensure payslips are received, reviewed, and uploaded/distributed according to process and client requirements.

**Process improvement \& operational excellence**

* Maintain and update payroll trackers, checklists, and country\-specific process documentation (SOPs) where needed.
* Drive standardization across countries by identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve data accuracy.
* Identify recurring payroll issues and propose improvements to reduce errors and improve turnaround time.
* Participate in payroll projects and company wide strategic initiatives (e.g., new country onboarding, ICP transitions, Product enhancements, automation, and standardization).

**Client, ICP, and internal stakeholder management**

* Serve as the main operational point of contact for assigned countries’ payrolls, providing timely responses to payroll\-related questions and requests.
* Partner closely with ICPs to resolve payroll issues, including discrepancies, missing inputs, late submissions, and statutory compliance concerns.
* Escalate risks early to the Regional Payroll Manager (e.g., missed cutoffs, incomplete inputs, payroll variances, or ICP delays).
* Support cross\-functional collaboration with Finance, Treasury, HR Operations, and Client Success teams as required.

**Payroll compliance \& documentation**

* Ensure payroll processing adheres to local statutory requirements, including taxes, social contributions, and mandatory reporting.
* Maintain accurate payroll documentation and audit\-ready records, including payroll registers, approval confirmations, and statutory filings where applicable.
* Support year\-end payroll activities such as tax forms, annual filings, and statutory reporting in partnership with ICPs.

**Let's Connect If You**

* 3–4 years of payroll experience, ideally in a multi\-country, regional, or outsourced payroll environment.
* Strong understanding of payroll fundamentals (gross\-to\-net, statutory deductions, payroll inputs, payroll approvals, and payroll reporting).
* Experience managing multiple payroll cycles (monthly and semi\-monthly) with strong deadline discipline.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to perform payroll validation and reconciliation checks.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, including working with external vendors or In\-Country Partners (ICPs).
* Strong proficiency in Google Sheets and/or Excel (sorting, filtering, pivot tables, lookups, data validation, and trackers).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* High ownership, accountability, and ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment.

**Nice to have**

* Experience supporting payroll under EOR / PEO models.
* Experience working with payroll operational tools such as:
* Jira (ticketing / issue tracking)
* NetSuite (finance / invoicing exposure)
* Expensify (expense reimbursement exposure)
* SendSafely or secure file transfer tools
* Global payroll workflow platforms (e.g., GWP)
* Exposure to payroll audits and internal controls.

**Ways of working**

* Based in India, Bangalore with a schedule that provides strong overlap with APAC and EMEA business hours.
* Flexibility to support payroll peak periods (cutoff days, payroll finalization, month\-end and year\-end).
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across several countries, clients, and partners while maintaining accuracy and service quality.

**Our Commitment to You**


At Pebl, we’re committed to supporting our team with comprehensive rewards and benefits designed to meet diverse needs across roles and locations. Our core offerings include:

* **Flexible Time Off** – Take the time you need to recharge.
* **Parental Leave** – Support for growing families.
* **Health and Dental Insurance** – Where applicable, to cover you and your loved ones.
* **Retirement Savings \+ Employee Incentive Plan** – Plan for the future while sharing our success.


Please visit our career page for more information.

**Pebl is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**


We power global teams and believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and impact. Employment decisions at Pebl are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive and do the best work of their career—anywhere in the world.

title: Head - Rings Plant
description:
**Head Rings \- Plant**  


**ABOUT TENNECO**

At Tenneco, we don’t follow industry standards; we set them, and we don’t settle for being best\-in\-class because we hustle to be *better than* best\-in\-class. Whether it’s our Core Values–radical candor, simplify, organizational velocity, tenacious execution and win–or our Get Stuff Done (GSD) mindset, we’re determined to become the most trusted partner and best manufacturer and distributor to the transportation industry.

How do we make it happen? Through the Tenneco Way. Fueled by our Core Values, a winning mindset and a relentless commitment to excellence, the Tenneco Way is how we win. It’s what keeps Team Tenneco bold, driven, and unapologetically focused on pushing past limits and redefining success.  



Here, you’ll work alongside a team of relentless problem\-solvers who are committed to making a tangible impact. If you’re ready to break boundaries, deliver results, and enjoy the ride along the way, you’ll thrive here.  

Want to learn more about who we are? Check out our website to discover the Tenneco Way.  


**ABOUT THE ROLE**

A **Product Manager** in the context of a **Ring Manufacturing Facility** would need a comprehensive skill set to ensure that production operations run smoothly, efficiently, and safely. Below is a breakdown of the critical skills for this position  


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
* In consultation with Value Stream Manager, he will be responsible to decide \& drive the operation strategies, establish Operational Objectives \& workplans for Ring Plant.
* This position will be responsible for the operational results of Ring plant with a head count of 500\+ employees,
* Reporting on to the Production Manager will be the Operations Managers of the main plant Machine Shop and Foundry, function heads of Quality, PPC, Maintenance \& EHS.
* The Product Manager will provide operational expertise and guide the operations team as well as work closely with the HR department to drive people strategy including but not limited to hiring, people development, employee engagement etc.,
* The position would also support HR in maintaining healthy relations with the Union and provide inputs during CLA negotiations,
* The role entails visits to customer locations and other plants as required,
* The position is expected to have proficiency in driving the plant P\&L, Safety Culture, Inventory, Optimization, Best in Class Mindset for Continual Improvement, Basic understanding of Regulatory compliances, Global bench marking/teach transfers, JIT production, Quality standards \& global maturity models, cost reductions \& avoidance

  


**JOB REQUIREMENTS*** Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of 20 years of experience in a manufacturing setting.

  


**Technical Expertise:**
* **Manufacturing Process Knowledge:** Understanding Ring manufacturing processes, including casting, machining, and finishing. Familiarity with the use of machines and other precision equipment.
* **Quality Control \& Assurance:** Knowledge of quality standards (such as ISO 9001, TS 16949\) and the ability to implement quality control systems for product consistency and defect reduction.
* **Troubleshooting \& Maintenance:** Expertise in diagnosing and solving mechanical and operational problems in production lines, as well as implementing preventive maintenance strategies.
* **Automation \& Robotics:** Familiarity with automated systems used in Ring production, including robotic arms, conveyor systems, and automated inspection systems.

  


**Leadership \& People Management:**
* **Team Leadership:** Ability to lead and motivate a diverse team of engineers, machine operators, and technicians. Strong interpersonal skills to ensure effective communication and coordination among departments.
* **Conflict Resolution:** Capable of addressing and resolving conflicts within the workforce, ensuring that morale remains high and productivity is not affected.
* **Training \& Development**: Implementing training programs for new employees and upskilling current staff to keep up with new technologies and best practices in Ring production.
* **Performance Management:** Setting clear goals, evaluating performance, and providing feedback to improve individual and team output.

  


**Operational Management**
* **Production Scheduling:** Planning and organizing production runs, managing work shifts, and ensuring production targets are met while maintaining high standards of quality and efficiency.
* **Inventory Management:** Overseeing the management of raw materials, semi\-finished goods, and finished products to optimize production flow and reduce costs.
* **Resource Allocation:** Ensuring that both human and material resources are used effectively, optimizing labor costs and raw material usage while minimizing waste.

  


**Financial Management**
* **Cost Control \& Budgeting:** Managing production costs, tracking expenses, and identifying areas for cost savings without compromising product quality or safety.
* **Capital Expenditures:** Making decisions on investment in new equipment or technology upgrades, including justifying the cost and evaluating the return on investment.
* **KPI Monitoring \& Reporting:** Monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) like yield rates, downtime, production speed, and cost per unit. Generating reports for upper management on production efficiency and financial health

  


**Safety \& Regulatory Compliance**
* **Health and Safety Standards:** Ensuring compliance with all workplace safety regulations and protocols to protect employees, particularly in environments with heavy machinery and high\-risk processes.
* **Environmental Regulations**: Overseeing the facility’s compliance with environmental standards related to waste disposal, emissions, and sustainability practices.
* **Risk Management:** Identifying potential risks in production processes and implementing measures to mitigate those risks, including worker safety, machine breakdowns, and supply chain disruptions

  


**Supply Chain \& Logistics :**
* **Supplier Relationship Management:** Establishing strong relationships with suppliers of raw materials like aluminum, steel, or cast iron. Ensuring timely delivery of materials to avoid production delays.
* **Logistics Coordination:** Managing the movement of materials into the plant and finished products out to customers. This includes warehousing, distribution, and transportation logistics.
* **Just\-In\-Time (JIT) Manufacturing:** Implementing lean manufacturing principles, including JIT inventory systems, to reduce waste, improve efficiency, and keep costs down.

  


**Continuous Improvement \& Lean Manufacturing:**
* **Lean Manufacturing:** Familiarity with lean principles like Kaizen, Six Sigma, or 5S to improve production efficiency, reduce waste, and enhance quality.
* **Process Optimization:** Continuously reviewing and refining production processes for better efficiency, lower cost, and improved quality.
* **Data Analysis \& Problem Solving:** Using data analytics to identify bottlenecks, improve workflows, and solve production issues proactively.

  


**Communication \& Reporting:**
* **Cross\-functional Collaboration:** Effective communication with R\&D, engineering, sales, and senior management to align production goals with organizational objectives.
* **Reporting to Stakeholders:** Providing regular updates on production performance, challenges, and improvements to senior leadership, stakeholders, or customers.
* **Customer Engagement:** Addressing customer requirements and feedback, ensuring that product specifications and delivery timelines are met.

  


**Adaptability \& Innovation:**
* **Technological Adaptation:** Staying current with advancements in manufacturing technology, such as additive manufacturing, AI\-driven automation, or advanced material science, that could improve production efficiency.
* **Innovation in Product Development:** Collaborating with R\&D teams to integrate new Ring designs or materials that may improve engine performance or reduce emissions**.**

  


**Strategic Vision:**
* **Long\-term Planning:** Developing strategies for facility expansion, new product lines, and international market entry.
* **Market Awareness**: Understanding the dynamics of the automotive, aerospace, and other industries that rely on Ring components and adjusting production strategies accordingly

title: Senior Learning & Development Lead
description:
**About the job**
-----------------


#### **Who are we?**

**RZR Global is an AI\-driven company specializing in mobile advertising solutions designed to fuel revenue growth. We leverage AI to discover audiences in a privacy\-first environment through trillions of contextual bidding signals and proprietary behavioral models. Our audience engagement platform includes creative strategy and execution. We handle 5 million mobile ad requests per second from over 10 billion devices, driving performance for both publishers and brands. We are headquartered in San Francisco, CA, with a global presence across the United States, EMEA, and APAC.**


#### **Role Overview:**



RZR is growing globally across the US, India, Philippines, China, Armenia, Belarus, and Europe. As the business scales, two critical gaps have emerged that are directly impacting performance, manager effectiveness, and cultural cohesion: the absence of a structured onboarding experience and the lack of any formal manager or leadership capability development.



The Senior L\&D Lead is a senior individual contributor role built to close those gaps and to build the learning infrastructure that will define how RZR develops its people as it scales. This is not a content coordination role. It is a program architecture role that requires strategic thinking, content creation, stakeholder influence, and rigorous measurement.



The first and most urgent mandate is to revamp, rebuild, and relaunch RZR Academy our global onboarding programs within the first 30 days. The second is to design and run a structured Manager Capability Development Programs for all new and first\-time managers globally. From there, the role expands into building a full\-stack L\&D calendar, function\-specific training, leadership development programs, and a performance management capability framework.


**Key Responsibilities**:


**1\.RZR** **Academy Global Onboarding Programs**


* Own, revamp, and relaunch RZR Academy as a structured, engaging, and globally consistent onboarding experience for all new hires across all markets
* Redesign the programs architecture modules, sequencing, delivery format (synchronous / asynchronous / blended), and regional adaptations
* Build or source onboarding content covering: RZR's business, culture and values, product and technology basics, tools and systems (Greenhouse, BambooHR, Lattice, Jira), people policies, and role\-specific tracks
* Create a 30/60/90 day new hire experience with structured check\-ins, milestones, and manager touch points
* Automate delivery where possible via available LMS or HR tech integrate with BambooHR, Notion, or similar tools
* Run a 90\-day effectiveness assessment for every cohort measure knowledge retention, role readiness, and cultural alignment scores
* Iterate and improve based on data track completion rates, satisfaction scores, manager feedback, and 90\-day performance correlation


**2\. Manager Capability Development Programs**


* Design and launch a structured First\-Time Manager Programs for all employees being promoted into a management role for the first time at RZR
* Build a New Manager Onboarding Track for experienced managers joining RZR, covering RZR's management philosophy, performance expectations, and people management tools
* Create a recurring Managers' Learning Series monthly or bi\-monthly sessions on core management topics: feedback delivery, performance conversations, handling conflict, building psychological safety, coaching vs. directing
* Run capability assessments before and after each programs to measure effectiveness and manager readiness
* Build a Manager Effectiveness Index a quarterly measurement framework using 360 data, engagement signals, and performance outcomes to track manager quality over time
* Partner with People Partners globally to identify managers who need targeted support and run bespoke interventions


**3\. Leadership Development**


* Design and pilot a leadership development programs focused on strategic leadership, organizational influence, and executive presence
* Build succession readiness programs in partnership with the Head of People identify high\-potential employees and create structured acceleration tracks
* Facilitate leadership workshops, offsite sessions, and calibration\-linked development conversations
* Create a leadership reading list, learning library, and curated external programs recommendations for L6\+ and above


**4\. Annual** **L\&D** **Calendar \& Content Management**


* Build and manage an annual global L\&D calendar covering all planned programs workshops, training sessions, and self\-directed learning cycles
* Own the content library create, curate, and maintain all learning materials: decks, e\-learning modules, toolkits, job aids, and facilitation guides
* Build a performance management training programs equipping managers and employees with the skills to run effective goal\-setting, mid\-year review, and year\-end calibration cycles
* Design training content for key People processes: POSH compliance, interview skills, onboarding managers, and tools training (BambooHR, Lattice, Greenhouse)
* Ensure all content is accessible, inclusive, and adapted for global audiences across RZR's markets


**5\. Function\-Specific \& Custom Training Programs**


* Partner with functional heads (Engineering, ML, Product, Sales, Finance, etc.) to identify skill gaps and co\-design targeted training interventions
* Run new hire role\-specific enablement programs beyond the general onboarding track especially for technical and client\-facing roles
* Support Sales and GTM enablement in partnership with functional leaders pitch skills, product knowledge, objection handling


**6\. Learning Measurement \& Effectiveness**


* Define and own the L\&D measurement framework Kirkpatrick Level 1 to 3 across all programs (reaction, learning, behaviour change)
* Build dashboards and quarterly reports for People leadership and ELT programs ROI, completion rates, effectiveness scores, and manager capability trends
* Conduct post\-programs surveys and 30/60/90 day follow\-ups to measure behaviour transfer
* Use data to make decisions on what to continue, improve, or retire


**7\.LMS** **\& Learning Technology**


* Evaluate and recommend an LMS or learning platform appropriate for RZR's size and global spread integrate with existing HR tech stack
* Manage content authoring tools (e.g., Google Slides, Notion, Canva, Articulate, or similar) to produce high\-quality, scalable learning materials
* Ensure all programs have digital delivery capability for async and remote learners across time zones

#### **Required Skills / Experience**


* 8–10 years of L\&D experience, with at least 2 years in a Senior L\&D Partner or Lead IC role in a global, fast\-paced tech or ad tech environment
* Demonstrated experience designing and running structured onboarding programs at scale not just administration
* Proven track record building manager capability or leadership development programs from scratch
* Strong instructional design skills ability to translate complex topics into engaging, learner\-centric content
* Experience running L\&D programs across multiple countries and time zones
* Data fluency comfortable defining KPIs, running surveys, and presenting effectiveness data to senior stakeholders
* Proficiency with content creation tools (Google Slides, Canva, Notion) and at least one LMS or e\-learning platform
* Excellent facilitation skills can run workshops, training sessions, and calibration conversations with confidence
* Strong stakeholder management can influence business leaders, partner with HRBPs, and navigate a matrixed global org
* Self\-starter with a builder mindset — comfortable working with ambiguity and no existing L\&D infrastructure
* Bachelor's degree in HR, Organizational Psychology, Education, or related field; L\&D certification (ATD, CIPD) is a plus

description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


Global R2R Delivery Lead **Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)**  

  

In this role, you will have the opportunity to drive complete, accurate, and timely completion of accounting activities for the assigned area (e.g., reporting, consolidation, etc.) within the General Accounting (GA) team. Each day, you will ensure compliance with internal guidelines, procedures, and external regulatory requirements. You will also showcase your expertise by overseeing, reviewing, and/or supporting the month\-end close process including account reconciliation, preparation of journal entries, balance sheet review, etc.


The Deputy Delivery Manager for Global Payroll Accounting will support the Global Accounting Delivery Manager in leading, coordinating, and optimizing payroll accounting operations across ABB's global workforce spanning 90\+ countries. This role is responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll processing while driving process improvements, maintaining data integrity, and supporting the Record\-to\-Report (R2R) function.  

  

The work model for the role is: /hybrid  

  

This role is contributing to the FAO \- RTR function in Bangalore**.** Main stakeholders are spread across 70\+ countries  

  

You will be mainly accountable for:

* Lead and oversee payroll accounting processes and controls across assigned geographies and entities
* Support the development and implementation of payroll accounting policies, procedures, and guidelines aligned with ABB standards and local regulations
* Coordinate with regional and country payroll teams to ensure timely month\-end and year\-end closing procedures
* Monitor payroll accruals, reconciliations, and journal entries to ensure accuracy and compliance with accounting standards
* Identify, analyze, and resolve payroll accounting discrepancies and reconciliation issues across countries
* Support internal and external audit activities, including audit preparation and documentation
* Collaborate with HR, Finance, and IT teams to implement system enhancements and process improvements
* Prepare and review payroll accounting reports and metrics for management and stakeholder reporting
* Ensure compliance with local tax regulations, labor laws, and accounting standards across all assigned countries
* Mentor and support team members in delivering consistent payroll accounting services
* Participate in projects related to process optimization, system implementations, and organizational improvements
* Maintain documentation of policies, procedures, and process flows for continuous improvement initiatives
  

**Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)*** **Essential Requirements**
--------------------------
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
* Minimum 8\-10 years of experience in payroll accounting, financial accounting, or related roles
* Strong knowledge of payroll processes, accounting treatment, and compliance requirements
* Experience in a multi\-country/multinational organization
* Proficiency with accounting software (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and MS Office applications
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Experience with process improvement and operational efficiency initiatives
* **Desirable Requirements**
--------------------------
* Professional certification: CA, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent preferable
* Experience with global finance shared services or business process outsourcing (BPO)

**Job Type:** Internship — 3 Months \| Unpaid \| Hybrid \| Gurugram, Haryana

**About Razano**

Razano is a fast\-growing home elder care platform based in Gurugram. We connect families with verified, trained nurses and caregivers for senior care, post\-hospital recovery, and daily home assistance. We are building India's most trusted home healthcare platform — and we are looking for driven, people\-smart individuals to grow with us.

This is a ground\-floor opportunity. You will work directly with the operations team and have real ownership of your work from Day 1\.

**About the Role**

As a Caregiver Sourcing \& Outreach Intern, you will be the first point of contact for caregivers who want to join the Razano platform. Your job is to find them, call them, understand their background, and bring them into our onboarding pipeline.

This is a calling and coordination role — you will spend most of your day reaching out to potential caregivers via phone, WhatsApp, and job portals. If you are comfortable talking to people all day and enjoy a fast\-paced environment, this role is for you.

You will work under the direct guidance of our senior Caregiver Operations Coordinator — a trained nursing professional — giving you hands\-on exposure to how verified medical staff and caregivers are sourced, screened, and onboarded in a real healthcare environment.

**What You Will Do Daily**

* Post caregiver job listings on Apna, WhatsApp groups, and other platforms every morning
* Call applicants and conduct a basic first\-filter conversation — experience, location, availability, caregiver type
* Identify genuinely interested candidates and pass them to the senior coordinator for onboarding
* Follow up with caregivers who have expressed interest but not yet confirmed
* Maintain accurate records in our shared Google Sheet tracker — updated daily without fail
* Support the caregiver operations team with coordination tasks as needed
* Assist the senior coordinator during caregiver onboarding and training sessions

**What You Will Learn**

* How verified nurses, GNM diploma holders, ANM certificate holders, and trained care attendants are sourced and onboarded in a structured healthcare platform
* The full caregiver verification process — document checks, credential verification, nursing qualification screening, background verification
* How healthcare professionals are trained, certified, and deployed for home elder care
* Talent sourcing, outreach, and pipeline management in the healthcare sector
* How a real healthcare startup operates end\-to\-end from the inside
* How to communicate professionally on calls and WhatsApp at scale
* Direct mentorship and day\-to\-day learning from a senior nursing professional and operations coordinator

**Who We Are Looking For**

* Final year students or recent graduates — any stream (BBA, BA, B.Com, BSc, Nursing, Healthcare Management, any)
* Freshers encouraged — no prior experience required
* Students from nursing, paramedical, or healthcare backgrounds will find this especially relevant to their career
* Strong communication skills in Hindi and English — you will be calling caregivers daily
* Comfortable making 20–40 calls per day
* Organised, reliable, and able to update records accurately
* Based in or able to commute to Gurugram
* Own smartphone is mandatory. Laptop preferred but not required.

**What's in It for You**

* Performance incentives available for interns who consistently exceed sourcing targets
* Genuine full\-time paid position offered at the end of 3 months for high performers — real salary, real role, real growth
* Direct learning from a senior nursing coordinator — understand how verified healthcare professionals are onboarded, trained, and managed
* Certificate of internship and a detailed letter of recommendation for your portfolio
* Hands\-on healthcare operations experience that stands out significantly on any resume or college placement record

**Consulting Dental Physician**

**Amura’s Vision**

We believe that the most under\-appreciated route to releasing untapped human potential is to build a healthier body, and through which a better brain. This allows us to do more of everything that is important to each one of us. Billions of healthier brains, sitting in healthier bodies, can take up more complex problems that defy solutions today, including many existential threats, and solve them in just a few decades.

Billions of healthier brains will make the world richer beyond what we can imagine today. The surplus wealth, combined with better human capabilities, will lead us to a new renaissance, giving us a richer and more beautiful culture.

These healthier brains will be equipped with deeper intellect, be less acrimonious, more magnanimous, and have a kinder outlook on the world, resulting in a world that is better than any previous time.

We find this vision of the future exhilarating. Our hopes and dreams are to create this future as quickly as possible and ensure that it is widely distributed and optimized to maximize all forms of human excellence.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**Role Description**

We are seeking a passionate and detail\-oriented Consulting Dental Physician to join our Medical Management team. As a Consulting Dental Physician at Amura Health, you will play a pivotal role in supporting and executing our functional oral health model. You will conduct client consultations, contribute to protocol development, and help bridge the critical connection between oral health and systemic wellness. Your expertise in preventive, functional, and integrative oral health care will be instrumental in advancing Amura's mission of reversing chronic diseases.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**Responsibilities**

* Client Consultations: Conduct scheduled oral health consultations with Amura clients via call/video, ensuring a thorough and empathetic approach to understanding their oral health status.
* Clinical Assessment: Collect structured dental histories with a focused emphasis on oral symptoms, their patterns, and potential systemic connections.
* Client Education: Educate clients on oral health using a functional, root cause\-oriented approach that aligns with Amura's integrative care philosophy.
* Clinical Documentation: Maintain accurate, detailed, and standardized consultation notes to ensure continuity of care and data integrity.
* Data Consistency: Ensure consistency in symptom tagging, clinical observations, and follow\-up points across all client interactions.
* Research Support: Support focused research tasks, including exploration of oral\-systemic health links, product research, and evidence summaries relevant to clinical practice.
* Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Collaborate with internal teams (physicians, health coaches, and other healthcare professionals) when oral symptoms intersect with ongoing health programs.
* Protocol Adherence: Work within defined clinical boundaries and contribute to the evolution of Amura's integrative care model.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**Requirements**

* Education: BDS qualification is mandatory.
* Experience: Fresher; prior experience in functional or integrative healthcare is not required but is a plus.
* Languages: Fluency in English is a must.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Interest in functional, preventive, or integrative healthcare.
* Ability to self\-learn and adapt to evolving protocols.
* Basic understanding of chronic disease impact on oral health.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

 We are not looking for someone who wants to “get into product”.
 



 We are looking for someone who already behaves like a product person.
 



 Someone who builds things. Ships things. Breaks things. Obsesses over user behaviour. Has probably done 3 internships instead of 1 because they were too curious to sit still.
 



 If you have spent your college years working with startups, building side projects, running experiments, writing product docs, doing growth hacks, or vibe coding random ideas at 2 AM — this will feel familiar.
 



 At

 , you will work closely with product, engineering to solve real user problems at scale. This is not a “shadow the PM and take notes” role. You will own things.
 



  





**The charter for this role will include** 




  




* Working closely with Product Managers to identify key user problems and business opportunities
* Speaking to users regularly and developing a deep understanding of user behaviour, motivations, and pain points
* Writing clear product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria for new features and product improvements

title: Story writer
description:
**Role Overview** PlotPix is building an AI native microdrama platform for mobile first, vertical storytelling. We create emotionally addictive, binge worthy fiction designed for short episode formats and fast audience payoff.

We are looking for a creative **Story Writer** who can create stories people feel compelled to continue. This is not a pure script formatting role. We already use AI heavily for speed and execution. What we need most is a strong creative mind with sharp instinct for storytelling, emotional progression, character build up, audience pull, narrative rhythm, and what makes a viewer care.

You should be someone who can take a rough idea and turn it into a compelling story engine. Someone who naturally thinks in terms of tension, reversals, chemistry, obsession, secrets, payoffs, emotional spikes, and binge flow.

This role is for people who are excited by new \*\*storytelling formats, can adapt to new audiences quickly, and can use AI as a multiplier rather than as a crutch. \*\*

**What You’ll Do**

* Create original microdrama story concepts with strong audience appeal
* Build lead characters viewers get emotionally invested in, root for, obsess over, hate, or can’t ignore
* Design high retention story arcs with clear emotional movement across episodes
* Shape narration flow, emotional flow, reveals, reversals, cliffhangers, and payoff moments
* Develop stories that feel highly bingeable in a short form vertical format
* Explore multiple creative directions for the same premise and identify the strongest one
* Adapt stories across genres, tones, and audience segments based on brief, platform need, or viewer response
* Work with AI tools to accelerate ideation, expansion, variation, and iteration
* Push past generic ideas and predictable beats to find fresher, sharper story turns
* Collaborate closely with directors, editors, and creative leads to refine stories from concept to final narrative
* Rewrite with intent, not just polish. Improve emotional impact, clarity, pace, and viewer pull
* Continuously learn what works for new formats, new markets, and changing audience tastes

**What We’re Really Looking For**

* Strong instinct for storytelling over scripting
* Strong sense of emotion over exposition
* Strong sense of viewer psychology over technical correctness
* Ability to create characters, conflict, tension, attraction, betrayal, longing, power shifts, and payoff
* Ability to judge whether a story feels flat, forced, repetitive, too safe, too slow, or not emotionally sticky
* High creative aptitude and fast pattern recognition
* Comfort with ambiguity, experimentation, and non traditional workflows
* Curiosity about what different audiences respond to and why
* Ability to use AI effectively while still bringing original taste and judgment

**Ideal Candidate** You may come from fiction writing, screenwriting, web series, audio drama, serialised content, fan fiction communities, creator writing rooms, ad films, narrative design, or any form of storytelling where audience pull matters.

**What matters most is that you can:**

* Think of strong stories fast
* Build characters people care about
* Sustain emotional momentum
* Adapt to feedback without making the story bland
* Create for modern mobile audiences without sounding synthetic or derivative

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in short form fiction, web series, episodic storytelling, romance, thriller, drama, or youth content
* Understanding of Gen Z and young adult entertainment patterns
* Familiarity with cliffhanger design, binge loops, and retention driven storytelling
* Experience using AI tools for brainstorming, iteration, or story development
* Comfort working in a fast paced creative environment with frequent iteration

**Experience** *We are open on background. Years matter less than story instinct. You could be a fit if you have: 3 to 5 years in fiction, screenplay, episodic, digital, or narrative writing or A strong portfolio that shows exceptional storytelling ability, even without conventional experience*

**What Success Looks Like In this role, success means:**

* You consistently generate strong story ideas, not just clean pages
* Your characters feel emotionally alive
* Your episode flows create pull and continuation
* Your stories adapt well to new formats and audience needs
* You improve the quality of the story, not just the wording of the script

**What We Offer**

* Working with a highly skilled, motivated and passionate group of people.
* Exposure to the full product development process from ideation to launch.
* Our culture of experimentation and creativity allows everyone to explore new ideas and approaches and think outside the box.
* Building a product for the global audience.
* A full pantry of munchies.

description:
**Company Overview**
 Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 We’re looking for passionate and talented Software Engineers to build out the machine learning platform and infrastructure that will power Docusign’s IAM. You will help support all aspects of the machine learning lifecycle, specifically areas like data storage, annotation, training systems, and telemetry infrastructure. Our team is responsible for building a platform that supports a team of machine learning engineers and data scientists and can serve AI solutions to Docusign at scale. This role will be a part of the AI platform team at Docusign, which builds analytics products that utilize AI, machine learning, and cutting\-edge deep learning based models to provide insights for the Docusign IAM. Our team is distributed across the San Francisco/Bay Area, Seattle, Ireland and India and you will be working collaboratively across these teams.
   

  

 This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Engineering \- AI Platform.
   

  

**Responsibility**
* Design, implement, and maintain backend and platform services that power Docusign’s AI and Insight capabilities for Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM)
* Build and enhance components across the machine learning lifecycle, including data ingestion and storage, feature/label pipelines, annotation tooling, training workflows, and model serving infrastructure
* Develop reliable, secure, and scalable RESTful services and APIs that expose AI\-powered insights and analytics to internal product teams and customer\-facing applications
* Contribute to service observability by adding metrics, logging, dashboards, and alerts while participating in incident triage and root cause analysis to improve system reliability
* Apply cutting\-edge AI tools to write clean, well\-tested code, participating in code reviews, following team engineering best practices for design, testing, and deployment, and continuously adapting to new technologies
* Collaborate closely with machine learning engineers, data scientists, and other backend teams to translate requirements into robust platform and product features
* Work as part of a distributed team across time zones, communicating clearly and documenting decisions to ensure alignment and smooth handoffs
* Learn and adopt new technologies continuously in AI platforms, data systems, and backend engineering to improve performance, reliability, and developer experience
* Demonstrate strong curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and industry trends, proactively exploring how they can be applied to our platform and products
* Challenge the status quo by questioning existing designs and processes and proposing innovative, AI\-driven solutions that improve developer experience and customer value

 Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
   

  

 What you bring
   

  

**Basic**
* 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend or platform services in a production environment (or equivalent internship/industry experience)
* Proficiency in at least one modern programming language used for backend development (for example, Java, C\#, Go, or TypeScript/Node.js) and familiarity with object\-oriented and/or functional design principles
* Experience developing and debugging services that interact with databases or data stores (SQL or NoSQL) and external APIs
* Experience with unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing, and with using version control and modern CI/CD pipelines
* Understanding of core distributed systems concepts such as scalability, reliability, latency, and fault tolerance


**Preferred**
* Experience building or supporting components of an AI or machine learning platform (for example, data pipelines, feature stores, training orchestration, model serving, or experimentation frameworks)
* Experience designing and operating cloud\-native services (for example, Kubernetes, Docker, serverless functions, or managed data and messaging services)
* Familiarity with observability tools and practices (metrics, logs, traces, and dashboards) and with on\-call or incident response processes
* Experience working with large\-scale data processing frameworks or streaming systems (such as Spark, Flink, Kafka, or similar)
* Exposure to machine learning concepts and workflows, and comfort partnering with ML engineers and data scientists to productionize models
* Experience with secure coding practices and building services that comply with privacy, security, and compliance standards
* Prior experience in SaaS or enterprise platforms, especially analytics or developer platforms
* Strong problem\-solving skills, a willingness to dive into unfamiliar areas across the stack, and a learning mindset
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with cross\-functional partners in a distributed team environment


 Life at Docusign
   

  

**Working here**

title: Intern - Talent & Culture
description:
What We Do
 
 FlytBase builds the world's leading Physical AI drone autonomy platform, powering mission\-critical operations across 300\+ enterprise sites in 40\+ countries. Its customers include Fortune 500 leaders such as Shell, CSX, UK Police, Airbus, Anglo American, Dole and Statnett. Explore some of our key deployments here \- flytbase.com/case\-studies.
 



  





 With a presence in the US and Pune, India, FlytBase is building the nervous system for large industrial sites. The company operates at AI speed, with autonomy and intelligence at its core. Our lean team thrives in a high\-agency, high\-velocity environment where AI is not a side project, it is the operating system for how we think, build, and grow.
 



  




 The Role
 
 This isn't your typical HR internship where you fetch coffee and update spreadsheets. You'll be FlytBase's Swiss Army knife for talent and culture — one day you're researching AI talent pipelines, the next you're creating content that shows why top engineers choose FlytBase over Google. You'll work directly with leadership on projects that actually matter: employer branding campaigns, community outreach experiments, recruiting automation, whatever moves the needle that week.
 



  





 We're looking for someone who gets excited about ambiguity, not overwhelmed by it. You'll have real ownership over projects that impact how FlytBase attracts and retains world\-class talent. This role could evolve into anything — full\-time recruiting, content marketing, operations — depending on where you create the most value and what lights you up.
 



  




 What You'll Own
 
 • Content creation for employer branding across LinkedIn, Twitter, and lifeatflytbase.com
 



 • Build the content \+ community \+ events engine for aiatflytbase.com
 



 • Community engagement with drone, AI, and startup ecosystems
 



 • Competitive intelligence on talent strategies in the Physical AI space
 



 • Find the high\-leverage recruits the team needs tackled this quarter
 



  




 Best Suited For
 
 • Students or recent grads who've already conducted hackathons, events, or clubs
 



 • Experience with AI tools — Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable for personal projects
 



 • Natural curiosity about how fast\-growing companies attract and retain talent
 



 • Comfortable with ambiguous projects that don't have clear playbooks
 



 • Strong writing skills — you can explain complex ideas simply
 



 • Social media savvy, especially LinkedIn and Twitter for professional content
 



 • Interest in drone technology, AI, or B2B software (bonus, not required)
 



 • Track record of finishing what you start, even when no one's watching
 



  




 What Makes You a Flyter
 
 • High agency: You see a problem and start solving it before being asked. You don't wait for perfect instructions.
 



 • AI\-native thinking: You reach for AI tools to 10x your output, not just to check grammar.
 



 • Learning velocity: You'd rather try three imperfect experiments this week than plan one perfect project next month.
 



 • Curiosity over credentials: You care more about understanding how things work than collecting resume lines.
 



 • Ownership mindset: You measure success by impact created, not hours logged or tasks completed.
 



  




 What We Don't Want
 
 • Internship collectors who want FlytBase on their resume but nothing else
 



 • People who need detailed instructions for every task and panic when projects evolve
 



 • Anyone who asks 'what exactly will I be doing?' before 'what problem can I help solve?'
 



 • Students who see this as a placeholder until they find something 'real'
 



 • People who avoid AI tools or treat them as cheating rather than force multipliers
 



 • Anyone who needs constant validation or can't work independently
 



  




 Why FlytBase?
 
 • H3 Philosophy: We're building a company that's Happy, Healthy, AND High\-Performing. Not as a balance—as a harmony. We move fast without burning out.
 



 • Radical Ownership: You won't need permission to experiment, build, or lead. If you see a problem, you own the solution.
 



 • Mazaa Aayega: Our internal motto. Yes, the work is intense. But it's also deeply meaningful and genuinely fun.
 



 • Systems That Scale: We don't celebrate one\-off heroics. We build compounding systems that create leverage.
 



 • In\-Person Energy: We work from our Pune office because proximity accelerates everything—ideas, feedback, trust, and impact, but travel globally for customer meetings, tradeshows, and deployments.
 



  




 The Perks
 
 • High agency team and sense of purpose
 



 • International Travel—we travel to all 6 continents (sorry, no business in Antarctica yet)
 



 • Thought leadership \& public speaking opportunities at online \& physical events
 



 • No\-cap budget for AI tools, courses, or experiments
 



 • Latest tech stack and tools—whatever helps you move faster
 



 • Top\-tier health coverage for you
 



 • Unlimited leave policy \& flexible working hours (no punch\-in/out)
 



 • A damn good team to work with
 



  




 Who You'll Work With
 
 You'll report to our Talent Lead but work closely with founders and department heads across the company. You'll get direct exposure to how leadership thinks about hiring, culture, and scaling a category\-defining Physical AI company.
 



  




 Ready to Fly?
 
 If you're the kind of person who builds side projects for fun and thinks AI tools are the best thing since sliced bread, we want to hear from you. This isn't just an internship — it's a chance to help shape how FlytBase thinks about talent in the age of Physical AI.

title: Senior Learning & Development Lead
description:
**About The Job**
**Who are we?**
 RZR Global is an AI\-driven company specializing in mobile advertising solutions designed to fuel revenue growth. We leverage AI to discover audiences in a privacy\-first environment through trillions of contextual bidding signals and proprietary behavioral models. Our audience engagement platform includes creative strategy and execution. We handle 5 million mobile ad requests per second from over 10 billion devices, driving performance for both publishers and brands. We are headquartered in San Francisco, CA, with a global presence across the United States, EMEA, and APAC.
   

  

**Role Overview:**
 RZR is growing globally across the US, India, Philippines, China, Armenia, Belarus, and Europe. As the business scales, two critical gaps have emerged that are directly impacting performance, manager effectiveness, and cultural cohesion: the absence of a structured onboarding experience and the lack of any formal manager or leadership capability development.
   

  

 The Senior L\&D Lead is a senior individual contributor role built to close those gaps and to build the learning infrastructure that will define how RZR develops its people as it scales. This is not a content coordination role. It is a program architecture role that requires strategic thinking, content creation, stakeholder influence, and rigorous measurement.
   

  

 The first and most urgent mandate is to revamp, rebuild, and relaunch RZR Academy our global onboarding programs within the first 30 days. The second is to design and run a structured Manager Capability Development Programs for all new and first\-time managers globally. From there, the role expands into building a full\-stack L\&D calendar, function\-specific training, leadership development programs, and a performance management capability framework.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
 :
   

  

* RZR Academy Global Onboarding Programs
* Own, revamp, and relaunch RZR Academy as a structured, engaging, and globally consistent onboarding experience for all new hires across all markets
* Redesign the programs architecture modules, sequencing, delivery format (synchronous / asynchronous / blended), and regional adaptations
* Build or source onboarding content covering: RZR's business, culture and values, product and technology basics, tools and systems (Greenhouse, BambooHR, Lattice, Jira), people policies, and role\-specific tracks
* Create a 30/60/90 day new hire experience with structured check\-ins, milestones, and manager touch points
* Automate delivery where possible via available LMS or HR tech integrate with BambooHR, Notion, or similar tools
* Run a 90\-day effectiveness assessment for every cohort measure knowledge retention, role readiness, and cultural alignment scores
* Iterate and improve based on data track completion rates, satisfaction scores, manager feedback, and 90\-day performance correlation
* Manager Capability Development Programs
* Design and launch a structured First\-Time Manager Programs for all employees being promoted into a management role for the first time at RZR
* Build a New Manager Onboarding Track for experienced managers joining RZR, covering RZR's management philosophy, performance expectations, and people management tools
* Create a recurring Managers' Learning Series monthly or bi\-monthly sessions on core management topics: feedback delivery, performance conversations, handling conflict, building psychological safety, coaching vs. directing
* Run capability assessments before and after each programs to measure effectiveness and manager readiness
* Build a Manager Effectiveness Index a quarterly measurement framework using 360 data, engagement signals, and performance outcomes to track manager quality over time
* Partner with People Partners globally to identify managers who need targeted support and run bespoke interventions
* Leadership Development
* Design and pilot a leadership development programs focused on strategic leadership, organizational influence, and executive presence
* Build succession readiness programs in partnership with the Head of People identify high\-potential employees and create structured acceleration tracks
* Facilitate leadership workshops, offsite sessions, and calibration\-linked development conversations
* Create a leadership reading list, learning library, and curated external programs recommendations for L6\+ and above
* Annual L\&D Calendar \& Content Management
* Build and manage an annual global L\&D calendar covering all planned programs workshops, training sessions, and self\-directed learning cycles
* Own the content library create, curate, and maintain all learning materials: decks, e\-learning modules, toolkits, job aids, and facilitation guides
* Build a performance management training programs equipping managers and employees with the skills to run effective goal\-setting, mid\-year review, and year\-end calibration cycles
* Design training content for key People processes: POSH compliance, interview skills, onboarding managers, and tools training (BambooHR, Lattice, Greenhouse)
* Ensure all content is accessible, inclusive, and adapted for global audiences across RZR's markets
* Function\-Specific \& Custom Training Programs
* Partner with functional heads (Engineering, ML, Product, Sales, Finance, etc.) to identify skill gaps and co\-design targeted training interventions
* Run new hire role\-specific enablement programs beyond the general onboarding track especially for technical and client\-facing roles
* Support Sales and GTM enablement in partnership with functional leaders pitch skills, product knowledge, objection handling
* Learning Measurement \& Effectiveness
* Define and own the L\&D measurement framework Kirkpatrick Level 1 to 3 across all programs (reaction, learning, behaviour change)
* Build dashboards and quarterly reports for People leadership and ELT programs ROI, completion rates, effectiveness scores, and manager capability trends
* Conduct post\-programs surveys and 30/60/90 day follow\-ups to measure behaviour transfer
* Use data to make decisions on what to continue, improve, or retire
* LMS \& Learning Technology
* Evaluate and recommend an LMS or learning platform appropriate for RZR's size and global spread integrate with existing HR tech stack
* Manage content authoring tools (e.g., Google Slides, Notion, Canva, Articulate, or similar) to produce high\-quality, scalable learning materials
* Ensure all programs have digital delivery capability for async and remote learners across time zones


**Required Skills / Experience**
* 8–10 years of L\&D experience, with at least 2 years in a Senior L\&D Partner or Lead IC role in a global, fast\-paced tech or ad tech environment
* Demonstrated experience designing and running structured onboarding programs at scale not just administration
* Proven track record building manager capability or leadership development programs from scratch
* Strong instructional design skills ability to translate complex topics into engaging, learner\-centric content
* Experience running L\&D programs across multiple countries and time zones
* Data fluency comfortable defining KPIs, running surveys, and presenting effectiveness data to senior stakeholders
* Proficiency with content creation tools (Google Slides, Canva, Notion) and at least one LMS or e\-learning platform
* Excellent facilitation skills can run workshops, training sessions, and calibration conversations with confidence
* Strong stakeholder management can influence business leaders, partner with HRBPs, and navigate a matrixed global org
* Self\-starter with a builder mindset — comfortable working with ambiguity and no existing L\&D infrastructure
* Bachelor's degree in HR, Organizational Psychology, Education, or related field; L\&D certification (ATD, CIPD) is a plus

Job Description
 



 Role \- Assistant Manager / Manager – Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) \& Talent Acquisition

 We are looking for a dynamic, business\-focused, and people\-oriented HR professional to partner with business leaders in driving key people initiatives across Human Resources Business Partnering, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Performance Management, Employee Engagement, Employer Branding, and Organizational Effectiveness.
 



 The role requires strong stakeholder management, execution excellence, analytical capability, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced retail environment while delivering impactful people solutions aligned with business goals.

 Talent Acquisition
 


* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment across corporate \& regional offices.

* Partner with business leaders to understand manpower, productivity, and organizational requirements.

* Act as a trusted advisor to managers and employees on HR policies, employee relations, and people matters.
* Support workforce planning, organization structuring, and succession planning initiatives.

* Drive employee engagement and culture\-building initiatives across stores, warehouses, and corporate teams.

* Support grievance handling, disciplinary actions, and conflict resolution.
* Monitor attrition trends and implement retention strategies.
* Ensure adherence to HR policies, processes, and compliance standards.



  





 Talent Management \& Performance Management
 


* Support implementation and execution of the Performance Management System (PMS).

* Strengthen employee experience across key touchpoints within the employee lifecycle.

* Strong understanding of HR Business partnering and Talent acquisition.

title: Human Resources Coordinator
description:
We are looking for HR Coordinators who can act as the face of the organization throughout the candidate journey. At CynLr, we believe alignment begins before a person joins, not after. The first interaction a candidate has with us shapes how they understand the company, the role, and the founder’s intent. In this role, you will do the heavy lifting of translating that intent into clear, thoughtful, and compelling communication across every stage of hiring and onboarding.
 



**About the Role** 




 As an HR Coordinator, your primary contribution will be to shape how candidates experience CynLr from the moment they discover an opportunity to the moment they join. You will support hiring teams in carrying the organization’s impression in an insightful, consistent, and high\-context manner. This role combines recruitment coordination, employer branding, stakeholder communication, process discipline, and early\-stage organizational alignment.
 



**What You Will Do** 




 • Applicant stage: Adapt job descriptions to the requirements and audience of each platform, including LinkedIn, the company website, and other relevant channels, to improve discoverability and attractiveness. Research candidate demographics, skill combinations, and platform behavior to determine where and when to publish roles for maximum relevance.
 



 • Campus recruitment: Support high\-coordination campus hiring efforts where the objective is not volume but identifying the right candidate in a difficult market. Help manage large applicant pools, communication flows, institution coordination, and branding touchpoints across campuses.
 



 • Candidate stage: Send and coordinate emails for tests and interviews, share preparation details, ensure support team availability, maintain test records and reports, and contribute to the design of filtering criteria using available assessment data.
 



 • Selected candidate stage: Manage candidate confirmations, coordinate interview logistics with relevant stakeholders, maintain interview performance records, and ensure timely follow\-up communication for all candidates who participate in the process.
 



 • Onboarding stage: Log new joiner details into internal systems, generate employee IDs, coordinate with IT for asset issuance, collect required documents, and administer internal and statutory induction programs.
 



 • Employer impression and communication: Act as a consistent and professional point of contact for candidates, helping remove communication roadblocks and ensuring that the organization’s values, expectations, and founder’s impression are carried meaningfully throughout the journey.
 



**Job Requirements** 




 • Domain and tool knowledge: Understanding of business operations, communication fundamentals, HR operations, employer branding, and negotiation. Familiarity with major job portals, applicant tracking systems, payroll software, and strong working knowledge of MS Office tools.
 



 • Core skills: Strong organization, documentation, and coordination skills, with the ability to interface effectively with external stakeholders. Excellent professional communication and negotiation skills, an understanding of human psychology, and the ability to manage expectations with maturity and clarity.
 



 • Behavioral tendencies: Critical thinking, responsibility, versatility, resourcefulness, availability, thoroughness, and strong attention to detail.
 



**What Success Looks Like** 




 • Roles are clearly defined, market\-informed, and aligned with the company’s stage and business needs.
 



 • Hiring processes are structured, candidate\-centric, and continuously improving through data and feedback.
 



 • Strong talent pipelines are built across experienced hiring, campus hiring, and institutional partnerships.
 



 • Employer messaging resonates with the right candidates across different talent segments and platforms.
 



 • Cross\-functional hiring teams are supported with clarity, responsiveness, and strategic insight.
 



**Who We Are Looking For** 




 • You are deeply curious and prefer understanding the problem before applying templates or assumptions.
 



 • You are action\-oriented and enjoy building, coordinating, and improving systems rather than only advising on them.
 



 • You think analytically and can connect business context, talent strategy, and market behavior.
 



 • You communicate clearly and can work effectively across founders, hiring managers, HR teams, branding teams, and operations stakeholders.
 



 • You are excited by startup environments where roles evolve quickly and thoughtful hiring can create outsized impact.
 



**Who You Will Work With** 




 You will work closely with the HR and Talent Management team for execution. You will also collaborate extensively with Branding and Tech teams to shape role narratives and hiring journeys, and partner with Operations and Finance teams where planning and budget considerations are involved.
 



**How Your Career Progresses** 




 We see this role as the starting point of a long\-term journey into Human Resources Management at CynLr. In a startup environment, the company evolves quickly and the needs of the organization expand continuously. Over time, this role can open pathways into specialized areas within HR, including talent acquisition, people operations, employer branding, onboarding, and broader organizational development.
 



**Why Join Us** 




 If you are excited by the idea of building hiring systems that are strategic, analytical, and deeply human, this role offers the chance to shape how a company discovers and develops talent from the ground up. You will help define not just who we hire, but how we think about roles, talent markets, candidate journeys, and long\-term organizational growth.

description:
**About WeRize**




 Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India’s largest full stack fintech platform for 500 million underserved middle\-class customers who live in 5000\+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd).
 



  





 This customer segments not served by private sector banks, Insurers and Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket\-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health and life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans, savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit. While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need properguidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn’t work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its ‘Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)’, a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support. These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000\+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions.
 



  





 Our social distribution platform supported by financially literate freelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on\-the\-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when comparedto upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn’t workfor this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on\-field teams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That results in very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousands of freelancers in 5000\+ cities only through its tech platform and without any feet\-on\-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize.
